subtitle_zm_c2dm_o2dm/zm_c2dm_o2dm_dnrt_: Let us cast those Augmentors further into the Dark Aether.
Left alone, they will cut us off. We must dispatch them immediately.
Their corruption will render the area toxic. We must dispel them at once.
Come, Soldiers of Noticus. The way to the Dark Aether must remain clear.
subtitle_zm_c2dm_o2dm/zm_c2dm_o2dm_krft_: We have a problem: Augmentors are corrupting our foothold in the Dark Aether.
Krafft here: our Dark Aether “beachhead” is infested with Augmentors.
Our operations in the Dark Aether are threatened by Augmentor worms.
Augmentor worms are befouling our Dark Aether area of operations.
Go with Norticus. Cleanse the Control Runes in the Dark Aether.
Kortifex’s worms are trying to block our access to the Dark Aether.
I need you to purge the Augmentor worms in our Dark Aether access point.
Stop Kortifex’s worms from polluting our foothold in the Dark Aether.
The worms beneath you can be sent far from here. Norticus, tell them how.
Even in the Dark Aether, Augmentors can be purged.
Cleanse the area. Cast those Augmentors to the far corners of their realm.
We cannot abide this infestation. But even there, the worms can be dispelled.
subtitle_zm_c2of_o2of/zm_c2of_o2of_blkr_: From this launch point, our chance of success is strong.
Feels strange to be back here. Sometimes Earth feels more like home.
It was pure luck we summoned Vercanna. From here, I can target my messages.
These orbs fare better when they need not breach the veil between worlds.
Vercanna the Last answered our call. Now others will flock to our banner.
We know this is working. Vercanna is our proof. Soon more will come.
At first, this was a shot in the dark. Now we know our orbs are reaching allies.
Whoever that orb reaches, may it bless us with more allies like Vercanna.
subtitle_zm_c2of_o2of/zm_c2of_o2of_krft_: From here, our messenger orbs travel even further into the Dark Aether.
Sending messenger orbs from here improves our odds of a response.
Protect the orb. Let it carry our message deep into that realm.
Safeguard the orb. It will seek allies in the furthest corners of the Dark Ather.
Now that Vercanna has joined us, we are still recruiting allies from the Dark Aether.
Despite Vercanna’s arrival, we need more allies. Prepare to visit the Dark Aether.
Attention: we must dispatch a message from the Dark Aether to recruit further allies.
Attention: we can now send our messenger orbs from within the Dark Aether.
Come back now. I worry when you spend too long... on the ”other side.”
Fingers crossed. Now let’s get you out of there.
Good work, but I’ll breathe easier once you are back.
Well done. Now come back to Earth. I can’t believe I just said that...
subtitle_zm_c2of_o2of/zm_c2of_o2of_krtx_: I see. Vercanna was fool enough to join you, so you send out more cries for help.
You call upon my enemies. From within my own realm? You go too far, Bellekar.
Those orbs were amusing when you launch them from the human realm. But not from here, Bellekar.
Bad enough you summoned Vercanna. I will not allow your “orbs” to reach more of my enemies!
Look at you, begging strangers for help. You only show how weak you are.
You cannot expect to tread in my realm, sending messages that seek my destruction!
Your messages go too far from there. You have crossed the line and I won’t allow it!
I cannot have you petitioning my enemies on my own doorstep. Kill them, my children!
Fine! Summon all the traitors, the two-faced lickspittles who betrayed me in the past! I’ll kill you all!
And there goes your message, to the darkest corners of the realm. You know not what horrors I banished there.
Think the next one to answer your call will be “nice” like Vercanna? Think again.
Whatever that message brings out of hiding, they are just as doomed as you are.
subtitle_zm_caiz_eaiz/zm_caiz_eaiz_blkr_: The Sisters of Agony -- still at Kortifex’s beck and call.
Of Kortifex’s inner circle, Zaballa is perhaps the deadliest.
The Deceiver’s words cut nearly as deep as her strikes.
Zaballa the Deceiver is a grave threat. Proceed with caution.
We possess a monkey bomb. Use it.
She is clever, but a monkey might fool her.
Remember: monkey bombs draw her attention.
Try distracting her with your monkey bomb.
subtitle_zm_caiz_eaiz/zm_caiz_eaiz_dnrt_: Zaballa the Deceiver. One of Kortifex’s assassins.
It seems Kortifex summoned allies from the other side. Major allies.
The Sisters of Agony. Kortifex’s right hands. Take this one seriously.
Careful, my soldier. The Deceiver is a deadly, vicious opponent.
Monkey bombs fool her. Use them.
You have a “monkey bomb.” Try it.
Divert her attention with a monkey bomb.
subtitle_zm_caiz_eaiz/zm_caiz_eaiz_dnvk_: Insults make poor weapons. But that never stopped Zaballa...
Kortifex’s bootlicker. This should be interesting.
The Deceiver. Watch out -- she fights dirty.
Most of us turned against Kortifex long ago. Not the Sisters of Agony...
Zaballa thinks monkeys are humans. Use that against her.
She goes after monkey bombs. That’s a hint, soldier.
We have a monkey bomb. Try it on her.
You can distract her with the explosive monkey.
subtitle_zm_caiz_eaiz/zm_caiz_eaiz_dsrx_: Zaballa the Deceiver. Long time, no see.
Plaything, did I ever tell you how much I hate my sisters?
Zaballa. Why couldn’t you stay ancient history?
It’s been ages since I left my sisters. Guess they didn’t quit me.
I bet your monkey bomb can throw her off.
Monkey bombs get her attention. Try one.
She goes after monkey bombs. Just saying.
Plaything, I’d say it’s time for a monkey bomb.
subtitle_zm_caiz_eaiz/zm_caiz_eaiz_krft_: Careful, she cannot be stunned, and she’s too smart for decoys.
My allies, she is highly resistant to stun attacks, and hard to fool.
Stunning her is out of the question. Decoys won’t work either.
I fear decoy grenades are as useless as trying to knock her down.
Aha! Unlike the rest of her, the masks are vulnerable.
Did you see that? Keep aiming for her masks.
Well done. It appears her masks are her weak spot.
Looks like you damaged her mask. Keep it up!
That hurt her! You hit her mask.
Her mask is damaged. Hit it again!
subtitle_zm_caiz_eaiz/zm_caiz_eaiz_vrcn_: The Sisters of Agony exterminated my people. Visit the same upon her.
I know this one well. She laughed as she murdered my brothers and sisters.
The Deceiver is a bringer of Death. Let us show her what the living can do.
Zaballa. I have quite a score to settle with this one.
Zaballa can be fooled by the thing you call “monkey.”
She can be distracted, but only by your “monkey bomb.”
You have a musical explosive. Try it against her.
subtitle_zm_caiz_eaiz/zm_caiz_eaiz_zbla_: Norticus! Remember when I almost killed you? Time to finish the job.
Norticus the Conqueror! I can smell you hiding in one of these mortals.
New allies for the Conqueror? He betrayed Kortifex -- he’ll do the same to you.
What do you call a traitorous has-been? Oh, hello, Norticus.
You there -- stuck with Norticus. He’s hitched himself to mortals before. I killed them all.
Norticus, I preferred your last human steed. Especially when I pulled out their heart.
The Sisters of Agony have found you, Norticus. There’s nowhere left to run.
I am Zaballa the Deceiver. Did Norticus not warn you I would come?
Bellekar, you insufferable know-it-all! Watch as I kill your pet!
Bellekar, I know you're here. Your Aether Shroud can’t hide your smugness.
Bellekar calls you “pupils.” I’m here to teach your final lesson.
Hiding behind humans, Bellekar? You’re not as smart as you think...
I once talked Kortifex out of killing you, Bellekar. File that under “regrets”...
Bellekar. Powerful enough to join the Sisters of Agony -- but never worthy.
Isn’t Bellekar nice? The Maya thought so. And paid the price.
Still slumming with mortals, Bellekar? How many cultures has your “help” destroyed?
The mighty Inviktor -- shackled to a mortal bag of bones! Pathetic!
I smell Inviktor. All his bluster can’t hide the stench of a coward.
What, no “hello,” Inviktor? We used to have such fun...
One of you harbors the Destroyer. Ask him why he fled the Battle of Obsidian Ridge.
Which of you is hiding Inviktor? Lord Kortifex sends his regards.
Inviktor! Kortifex says he’ll take you back. Really! Just kill your human and let’s talk...
I sense... mindless rage. How have you been, Inviktor?
Zaballa the Deceiver has come for you. Inviktor would tell you to run.
Saraxis, dear sister, you abandoned us for these fragile things?!
Hello, Saraxis. Remember me? There’s so much you don’t remember...
A new plaything, Saraxis? Did you tell them about your sisters?
Oh, Saraxis. You’re a mere shadow of your true self. Trust me, I know.
Sister Saraxis. Black sheep of the family. You were the best of us -- or should I say the worst?
Saraxis, my sister -- come back to us. Or die. I’m good either way.
I may be “the Deceiver,” but this much is true: Saraxis will abandon you.
Whoever’s bonded to Saraxis: ask her about her father. *laughs*
Vercanna the Last. Why the hell are you even here?
Vercanna, you should’ve stayed hidden. Now you’re back in my sights!
I hunted down Vercanna’s clan. Time to finish the job.
Vercanna the Last. Today you shall be the First -- to die!
I sense Vercanna’s inner light. About time we snuff that candle.
A human bonded with Vercanna. That has to be its own special punishment.
Vercanna, remember me? I’ve waited too long for another shot at you.
Why does it smell like ashes and tears? Oh. Vercanna is among you.
You hurt me, I kill you.
Here I go again...
You asked for this...
Uh-oh, look out now...
Now you see me, now you’re dead...
You’ve got this coming...
This is for breaking my mask!
One mask is all you’re taking from me...
What is this? A tiny red-blood?
I see you, little one!
Such awful music! That alone earns you death!
Huh. A tiny, hairy human...
Bouncing, clanging -- you’re just begging to die!
Tricky little red-blood. You’re mine now.
What manner of human are you?
Irritating little thing. You have to go.
My face!
What have you done to my mask?!
That mask was sacred!
Damn you! Kortifex gave me that mask!
My mask! You will die for that!
You break my face, I break you!
No! Not my mask!
Ah! I’ll take your face now!
No! Not another!
Stop it! Stop taking my faces!
That is the last mask you take from me!
Another mask?! This has to stop!
That’s two masks! No more!
One face left -- that’s all I need.
Two masks broken -- that is just cruel!
[pain cry] Stop breaking my masks!
subtitle_zm_cdvc_dvcn/zm_cdvc_dvcn_vrcn_: Oh dear -- better help your friend out.
Your ally is either making new friends, or they’re about to die.
That human is in trouble -- do you know them?
Might be time to make a new friend -- that one’s about to die.
Looks like you need to save your partner again.
Did you want to rescue your friend, or shall we move on?
That human is about to go down -- and take you with them if you’re not careful.
Oh bother -- that little human is definitely about to die.
Better help your friend, unless you want to be the Last of your kind.
Your friend can’t keep clear of revenants, can they?
The Web of Life ensnared them.
Together we are as unstoppable as the Web of Life itself.
Life for one means death for another. It is always this way.
They fell before the Last and strongest of an ancient race.
What would my people think, to see our power wielded by a human?
Who is bidding auf wiedersehen now, Von List?
It is a most ancient truth: enemies die that you may live.
Very good, seedling. You make Vercanna proud.
Kortifex meddled with Nature. Now Nature is meddling back.
Those who sow death have now reaped their harvest.
I am the Last of my kind, inheritor of power from all who came before me.
I am Vercanna the Last, and I mean to end this war on my terms.
Kortifex took everything from me. It’s time I return the favor.
Come, seedling -- I will protect you from the darkness ahead.
Don’t hesitate to ask for my help.
Now, child -- call my healing down and become unstoppable.
I stand ready to heal you, my seedling.
Call upon my power -- let it heal your wounds.
You humans are always falling apart. Let me help.
If you fall without seeking my help, then you deserve it.
I will bring you life -- you will bring me Kortifex.
My aura is ready when you need it, seedling.
The power of my people is yours to command -- for now.
Summon my aura to wash away your pain.
Safety first, I always say.
Vercanna’s true power is unleashed at last!
To your health, little seedling.
You see, Kortifex! Vercanna the Last is still in the fight!
The power of Life surrounds you -- breathe it in.
My people live on through me -- and now so do you.
Behold the true power of what you call the Dark Aether!
Let the Web of Life restore you, from your leaf-tips to your roots.
Behold a power not even Kortifex can match!
Be strong -- they cannot take this ground from you.
You were not strong enough, my seedling. I should have known.
Only destruction follows where I go.
Kortifex wins again. This is why I don’t trust humans.
My human is dead. I must find another...
Kortifex’s minions are a blight. Hunt them to extinction, child.
The revenants betray the natural order. They must be pruned.
Hello, seedling. Heed me, and we shall bleed Kortifex dry.
Kortifex thinks he is in control. You and I will show him his error.
This box is fertile ground for weaponry.
A box made of wood. The bones of some poor, defenseless tree.
Weapons sprout from this box, almost like living things.
Water your roots with this, seedling, and grow strong.
Soak up our strength, my child.
Drink of this fountain. Let it nourish you.
Your kind made this book, human. Use it to strengthen me.
The secrets in this Tome can unlock my abilities to their fullest.
You call this the “Tome of Rituals.” Learn to use it.
Altars used to be life-affirming. This one reeks of death.
For the price of a heart you can bargain for power here.
“Covenants” are unbreakable promises. And this Altar promises power.
“Pack a punch.” I do not like the name, but I love what it does.
Fiery forges like this are seldom good for the Wilds. Use it, anyway.
This device gives Life to your weapons -- that they may better deal Death.
Did no one teach you to count, child? Go kill some more.
You’ll have to take what you need from their undead flesh, I’m afraid.
Just start using that weapon of yours. We’ll have what you need before you know it.
In this place, seedling, you must earn the things you need.
Seems you have some more work to do, little one.
Careful with that -- don’t want any accidents.
What sort of trouble are you getting up to now?
Never a shortage of creativity when it comes to killing.
Come, little seedling -- let us put that thing to the test.
Me, you, and your new little toy. What a family we make.
Go on, child. Just remember to clean up after yourself.
An obscenely powerful weapon. Good thing you have my guidance.
Remember to share your toys with your guests.
Use that wisely. Of course, destroying your enemies is wise.
I prefer more peaceful altars. But this one will do for now.
You’ve given your heart more wisely than most humans do.
Nasty little things, those hearts.
We must stop Kortifex -- this is how we do it.
Sacrificial hearts. Ugh. I prefer the heartless -- like plants. And jellyfish.
Life. It’s all making choices, then dealing with the consequences.
War corrupts even sacred altars into abominations.
All hearts are corrupted in one way or another.
Whatever you choose, seedling, make sure the revenants pay.
Don’t dally, child -- that altar hungers for your heart as well.
Just when I thought you were running out of ways to kill.
Watch your fingers with that box -- who knows what goes on in there?
Life seldom gives what you desire, but always what you need.
You place a startling amount of trust in that wooden box.
So much in warfare comes down to chance. Like a weapon. Or survival.
Children’s games. Just grab something and get on with it.
I sense an old and unknowable power in those timbers.
Part of growth is learning to deal with the unexpected.
Kortifex uses any weapon at his disposal. We must do the same.
Nothing is certain but Death -- and my eventual revenge.
Never work for less than you are worth.
Fate is rarely generous -- make the most of this.
Now is not the time to hold back, little one.
Human or “demon,” we must all make the most of the chances we get.
Go on -- pillage and plunder, or whatever it is you humans like to do.
Humans are all too delicate. Don’t be angry -- it’s true.
Fresh armor -- like a mother’s warm embrace.
It’s always wise to bundle up against the storm.
The Wilds were my armor. But one cannot hide forever...
I’d prefer you avoid getting hit altogether. But we’ll take the armor...
Careful, child -- that’s hot.
Your weapon spreads its petals like a tenebrous night-blossom. Er, trust me, that’s good.
Imagine the gardening tools that thing could forge.
Kortifex wields wildfire. We must do the same.
You humans build the most curious contraptions.
If that’s how you want to spend your earnings, I won’t stop you.
Good -- your enemies aren’t getting any weaker.
If my brethren had such weapons, they might still be alive.
There is power in that device even Kortifex does not comprehend.
Kortifex understands only Death. So let us speak his language now.
Be thankful for that gift -- though you certainly earned it.
Spend your allowance wisely, my seedling.
That windfall only takes us closer to destroying Kortifex.
Nature’s bounty is plentiful, even in a place like this.
Buy yourself something nice, child. Or something nasty...
Trust me, seedling -- at that price, it’s a steal.
Oh I may just pick something up for myself.
One never gets something for nothing. But this is close.
Get to the box -- you won’t stop Von List without firepower.
Time to go to market.
Time to reap a harvest of death.
If they were smart, they’d run. We both know they’re not going to run.
We have the wind at our backs now...
Prune them, child -- they are ripe for the picking.
Your enemies are like weeds. Pull them up by the roots.
A favorite elixir of my homeland -- what do you think?
Ignore the stringy bits. We just add them for... texture.
My people brewed wonders, but now they are gone, and their secrets with them.
Human palates are too delicate for the fruits of the Dark Aether.
Don’t worry, it’s all organic.Though not exactly vegan...
I see your expression, child. Let’s just say it’s an acquired taste...
Oh, don’t put on such a sour face.
Careful not to spill -- you don’t want that on your skin.
Well it was brewed for “demons,” so I’m not sure what you expected.
Did you really just drink that without asking what’s in it?
Nature is generous to those who protect it.
You have what you need -- now get on with your chores.
That should hold you over for a while.
Deluge them in fire and blood.
They are many, seedling -- you will need every round.
In all worlds, across all times, all creatures fear fire.
Kortifex set my world to the torch. It pleases me to return the favor.
I do not like fire -- but it does have its uses.
That blast -- it reminds me of the Nether Wars.
Take a moment to collect yourself, child. Then get back to it.
Careful with that book -- its words are not meant for you.
I appreciate the gift, my seedling. I will repay it in turn.
My power is one of giving. It is rare for me to receive.
The more Life grows, the less room there is for Death.
I wield the power of Nature itself, and that power has no limits.
Oh my. Seedling, you are a wonder.
Like a storm over the sea, I grow ever stronger.
Kortifex always underestimated my kind. That will be his undoing.
Don’t try to read that book, child. Its secrets will break your mind.
When they died, my kin passed their power to me. You have helped me grow stronger still.
Mind yourself, little sprout -- they’re all around you.
I didn’t survive this long by letting enemies outflank me!
Better move, seedling. It would be a pity to end things like this.
Do not tarry, child -- they’re on your heels.
Are you sure this is where you want to be?
This is no place to stop and smell the flowers.
Get out of here while you still can.
You’ve got the wrong sort of friends all around you.
Don’t let them corner you, child.
Have you lost your reason? Get out of there!
subtitle_zm_cmcp_cann/zm_cmcp_cann_krtx_: It’s that magical time of year. When we turn your guts to garlands and drink eggnog from your skulls.
Spend your holidays with Kortifex. I’ll send your loved ones whatever’s left over.
You’ll be home for the holidays -- giftwrapped in a coffin.
You’ll find no silent night here, red-bloods. My night never ends.
Ahh... the holiday season. A perfect time for my children to feast.
I have a gift for all of you. Just let my “elves” deliver it.
Von List calls this time of year “Weihnachten.” I call it your funeral.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_cann/zm_cmcp_cann_zann_: Think you’re on the Nice List, do you?
subtitle_zm_cmcp_cbea/zm_cmcp_cbea_beat_: I hear you, moving out.
Sure thing, time to get to work.
I can do that.
Just when I thought we were almost done.
I’ll do what you ask. (to self) For now.
Bien recu.
All right, I am on it.
You can trust me to see it through.
Affirmatif, I’ll get it done.
Won’t be a problem.
Where are you manners, Monsieur?
You want me to look like you, is that it?
Connard! J’en ai jusque-là!
Keep your hands off me, porc!
Damn, that one got me!
Merde! That hurt!
Merde! That one should file his claws.
Unhand me, salaud!
Use your words next time!
You will have to do better than that!
You were the best of us, singe. C’est la vie.
Merci, monkey. I will not let your sacrifice be in vain.
I don’t know where you come from, singe -- but you’re French in my book.
Nobody commands a room quite like my simian friend.
May the cherubins give you cymbals twice as big.
To go out with such a bang -- what more can any of us ask?
I warned you not to get so close.
Coming through, out of my way!
Maybe that will teach you some manners.
Did no one ever teach you to brush your teeth?
It is called hygiene, you porc.
I just cannot take their stench anymore.
At least this close, there’s no doubt if you got them.
Close enough to see the reds of their eyes.
That one had no fear of intimacy.
Pardon, monsieur.
Headshot! I love those!
Combine face with bullet, whisk until smooth.
I wish I could teach everyone to shoot like me, but...
Right between the eyes.
C’est dommage -- your face was your best feature.
That one had such a nice smile.  Oh well.
Pop! Like a ripe grape.
It was a charming smile... if you ignore the decay.
Désolé, I just thought your face could use a touch-up.
What? I didn’t like the way it was looking at me.
Sturmkrieger. [sighs] The Nazis are so dramatic.
Nothing worse than a bully.
Yes, you’re very big and strong, congratulations.
No bullies in my classroom.
Eh, bien. Another beefed-up Sturmkrieger.
You drank lots of Nazi milk growing up, yes?
Massive undead Nazi. What a time to be alive.
I’m sure he wasn’t compensating for anything.
All right, whose idea was it to give Nazis guns like that?
Learn some manners next time, Sturmkrieger.
Well, I guess I better not stop now.
Don’t know how many I just took out. Better nab a few more, eh?
I may not enjoy killing you, but I do not not-enjoy it.
I’m sorry, but you and your friends keep getting in my way!
For La Résistance! For France!
Waouh! They do not stop for anything, do they?
Mon Dieu, they just keep coming.
Anybody want in on this? No? Guess I’ll just keep shooting then...
Buy one, get entire horde for free!
Your numbers are irrelevant! (to self) Your stench is not.
You brought that on yourself, Monsieur.
Kindly keep your hands to yourself next time, eh?
My mother taught me not to start what you cannot finish.
Revenge is a dish best served to others.
You would hit a woman? Sur mon cadavre!
Aw, did I hit you too hard? Mauviette.
You should not have left me alive.
I do not condone revenge, but that felt good.
Consider your debt paid, revenant.
Hit me once - I kill you.
Ta gueule, you insufferable creature.
DID YOU SAY SOMETHING? WHAT?
Boom-Schreier. The most German thing I’ve heard all day.
Mon Dieu, my ears...
I do not tolerate screaming in my classroom.
Indoor voices, please!
At least they won’t be surprising anyone.
Keep your opinions to yourself, merci.
Yes, yes we heard you, we all heard you...
Squeaky wheel gets the... explosion?
I think I can use this.
I’ll take this, since no one else has.
Now this I can use to great effect.
Now I wish I had more pockets.
Anyone else want to carry this? Non? Guess it’s me then.
Can’t just leave this here all alone, can I?
You’re with me now, mon ami.
I call prems on this one!
Amazing what you find, if you keep your eyes open.
This will come in handy, I’m sure of it.
Contrary to what you might think, I like big guns.
Avert your eyes, Profeseur - this will not be pretty.
Line up nicely, boys and girls.
Today’s lesson? Firepower.
School is in session. Today’s letters? L-M-G.
I am not above getting my hands dirty.
Violence is not my goal, but it is a tool I will use.
Not an elegant weapon - but I have always been practical.
Sometimes we must fight evil, claw to claw.
Every good French woman knows when to roll up her sleeves and get to work.
Now this is my tasse de the.
The weapon of La Résistance.
We used such rifles to great effect in the liberation of Paris.
Class, watch closely as I show you how it’s done.
Slow - but deadly in the hands of un expert.
Simple, effective, and very messy.
Firepower with a kick.
This will make short work of those Nazi sacs de merde.
For when you really want to make a mess.
Who wants to meet my new chaperone?
Light and snappy, just the way I prefer.
For those who are fast on their feet.
Swarms of enemies require a swarm of bullets.
Not very efficient, but sometimes I like to make a mess.

Try the box while it’s cheap. I just love to watch it go.
An easy kill counts no less than a hard one.

Mow them down, mortal.
Strike while they are vulnerable.
This stuff’s not meant for humans. But I don’t mind experimenting.

Knock it back. I need you strong.

subtitle_zm_cmcp_cwde/zm_cmcp_cwde_wade_: Roger wilco.

I’d shoot your face again -- if you still had one.
Headshot. Works like a charm.

I’ve fought bouncers tougher than you.

Tim-berrr!

Mass casualties. That’s what bomber pilots do.

Feels like I’m doing all the work around here.
I’m on a roll here. Let it ride.
I’ll carpet-bomb all your asses.

Sorry, you slack-jawed losers, but I like my elbow room.
I. Am. Devastating!
Right back at ya.

Choke on that, asshole.
You don’t get to hit me and walk.
Sweet, sweet vengeance.
No bogie goes unpunished.
Shut. The fuck. Up.

Professor calls ‘em Boom-schriers. Emphasis on “boom.”
Kamikaze corpses. I’m sick of this war.
You screamin’ Mimis are workin’ my nerve.

They’d kill more of us if they kept their traps shut.
Even for walking corpses those things are nuts.

Taking this onboard.

I know valuables when I see ‘em.
Essential gear.
