subtitle_zm_cmcp_deal/zm_cmcp_deal_blkr_: It was curiosity that first led me to your kind. I see something new and I want to know more. And you humans are never not intriguing.
I’ve had many friends and hosts among your kind. The ones who understood me best were the Maya of the Yucatán.
They wrote. They studied. They sacrificed. And they made war. All with a clarity of purpose that drew me to them irresistibly.
I was there throughout their rise and fall. I tried in vain to teach them rune magic. Alas, none was prepared for everything I offered.
I have watched your nations and cultures come and go ever since. I always look for signs that they are heading for collapse.
But I have never seen anything like this current conflict. This second World War is the most consequential event in the brief history of Humanity.
The outcome of this war will be decided by you, my pupils. Right here. And if you accept my counsel, I can help you avoid disaster.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_deal/zm_cmcp_deal_dnrt_: We are new to you, human. But your kind is not new to us. Nothing has been... “new” in eons.
Since time began, we of the Dark Aether have been at war. And none know the ways of warfare better than I.
For this reason, the mightiest lord of the Dark Aether, Kortifex the Deathless, placed me in command of his armies.
We launched the Netherwars upon his rivals, and for a time it seemed we would crush them.
But Kortifex is a cruel master. Loyalty is something he neither feels nor inspires.
As I watched his enemies unify into a joint resistance, I knew he could never truly succeed.
When I joined them and we toppled his throne, Kortifex swore vengeance. He sees the human Von List as the means to that end.
There are those in the Dark Aether who would still support his return. But most would do anything to help us stop him here.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_deal/zm_cmcp_deal_dsrx_: Listen closely, plaything. I know your kind better than the others. Better, even, than Bellekar.
I’ve played with you clever monkeys since you raised your first cities.
And you never cease to surprise me. There are so many ways to have fun with you -- so many paths to lead you down.
I hope that doesn’t scare you. It shouldn’t. When someone who’s older than time says you’re special, pick up your chin and do what they say.
My playthings only meet bad ends when they dig in their heels. They have notions of “right and wrong,” “good and bad” -- made-up nonsense that just gets in the way.
The ones who played well with me became emperors and conquerors... and some were even peacemakers.
You’re lucky you met me, little mortal. Loosen up and everything will turn out just fine.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_dert/zm_cmcp_dert_blkr_: I never get tired of watching you. Humans, I mean. Humanity.
Always exploring, always building, always finding new and interesting ways to kill each other.
My name is Bellekar the Warlock. I wrote the histories of the Netherwars. I was right there, on the battlefields of the Dark Aether.
I’ve seen so many armies clash -- the outcome decided by speed, deception, firepower, magic, the weather...
But you humans find the most... poetic ways to win, and stalemate, and completely lose the day. I cannot get enough of it.
So if you and I are to chart a path to victory, don’t be shy. Share your insights. Let me know what you’re thinking.
The more I understand your ways of war, the more I can help you.
Secrets have their place in combat, but keep nothing from me. You would only be hurting yourself.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_dert/zm_cmcp_dert_dnrt_: How did it come to this? I was once General Norticus -- supreme commander of the Night Legions. Norticus the Conqueror.
Your tiny mind cannot comprehend what that means, but my adversaries in the Dark Aether would throw down their weapons and beg for mercy at the mere mention of my name.
Heh. Mercy. I had no mercy. Just a string of victories that stretched back to the dawn of time. And now?
Now I am shackled to a pathetic bag of blood whose lifespan is as brief as it is meaningless. Oh, how I have fallen.
But I have fought my way out of bleaker circumstance. And you are currently the only weapon at my disposal. So you will have to do.
I will hone your skills, human. I will make you unstoppable. But only if you heed my commands.
I save your world, you get me back to mine.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_dert/zm_cmcp_dert_dnvk_: “Special Forces.” Is that what you call yourselves? I don’t see anything special about you.
I am Inviktor the Destroyer. I am a veteran of a thousand battles on the wastelands of the Dark Aether.
I have witnessed the best trained soldiers falter on the field of battle.
And I have seen half-starved mothers kill warriors twice their size to protect their young.
You never know who is... special until blood is spilled and backs are to the wall.
It is said all combat is based on deception, but nothing reveals the truth like a fight to the death.
So don’t tell me who you are, human. Show me.
Bathe in the blood of your enemies. Only then will I know you are not wasting my time.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_dwal/zm_cmcp_dwal_krtx_: You seem unsettled, Wolfram. I sense something weighing on your mind -- distracting you from our current efforts.
I told you it would take time before I could raise your entire army. Why are mortals so impatient?
Then I suggest Die Wahrheit completes your instructions. Only then can I raise your army of millions.
Wolfram, you remind me of someone I knew long ago. He was a pharaoh in the land of the Nile.
He saw himself as a god, and everyone around him as vermin. In fact, he was... delightfully cruel.
But you, Oberführer Wolfram Von List, are a rare and special find. You have the blackest heart I have ever encountered in a human.
You might have been royalty where I come from -- had you not been born on this pathetic ball of dust.
I tell you this not to flatter you, but because I expect the world from you. And you will deliver it unto me.
This power I grant you is not something I would share with just anyone. But I am willing to see your dreams fulfilled and your enemies crushed.
For you are a worthy vessel. You are the instrument of my revenge.
I still have supporters. More than enough, Wolfram. Just do your part here. I will ensure your success.
And I shall help you eradicate those pests. But you need to have faith in our partnership. You are... my other half now.
Only if you succeed do I get what I want. Remember that. Our goals are intertwined.
Your success is my success. That is all the reassurance you should need.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_dwal/zm_cmcp_dwal_vlst_: I am not distracted, Kortifex. I am simply under pressure to produce results.
Perhaps because we do not have thousands of years to see plans to fruition. We are mortal, after all. But my concerns are specific.
Right now, the allies are amassing troops in the British Isles. I need to mobilize before they launch an invasion across the English Channel.
I look forward to that day, Kortifex. When our enemies make landfall in Calais, I want the undead there to greet them on the beaches.
I need you to be honest with me: how much support do you really have back in the Dark Aether?
I do not expect them all to match your power -- or even come close. But more help is needed to reach our goals.
If only it were that easy. Krafft and his new allies are setting back Die Wahrheit’s timetable.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_dwrt/zm_cmcp_dwrt_vlst_: Can you hear me, professor? Of course you can.
What else is there for you to do than sit at your radio and pray for salvation?
I should have sent you to the camps when we first met. It makes my skin crawl to even breathe the same air you do.
You were my greatest mistake -- but one I can still correct.
So go on, play your games. Do your worst. Those soldiers who are helping you are braver, finer people than you could ever be.
And, still, they will die like dogs. One by one.
And as they do, I shall savor the pain it brings to that soft, degenerate heart of yours.
Yes, professor, I will make sure you die last.
The world I usher in will have no place for your kind. Only the strong. The pure.
A world cleansed by fire will suit me quite well. You are but the kindling.
This is Oberführer Wolfram Von List, commanding officer of SS Battalion Die Wahrheit.
I am broadcasting on an open channel to the soldiers assisting Professor Gabriel Krafft.
I am not sure why you answered his cry for help. Surely you know by now if you continue to oppose me I will eventually kill you all.
But it does not have to end that way. I am asking you to reconsider your mission. It simply makes no sense.
The man you are helping is... hardly a man at all. He is a traitor who cannot be trusted.
He once served Die Wahrheit, do you know this? It was he who made possible my union with Kortifex the Deathless.
There would be nothing for you to battle here, had that little demonologist not lent me his expertise.
This is really all his fault, if you must point a finger. And now he expects you to risk your lives just to undo his mistakes?
This is the very definition of a fool’s errand. But you can still withdraw. Stop helping Krafft and I will allow your retreat.
Continue aiding him, and you will all die horribly. And, after that, you will take your place in my army of the dead.
Oberführer Von List to all Die Wahrheit personnel across all theaters of special operations.
As of now, I am altering our timetable, reducing the time allotted by half.
Yes, I know this is drastic, but I have always asked much of you, and you have always delivered.
We set out together to scour the globe. We sought objects of power no one believed existed, to turn the tide of a war no one believed could be won.
And yet here we are, harnessing forces beyond mortal ken, perched on the precipice of the greatest advancement in the history of human warfare.
Our enemy now is not that ragged band of soldiers delivering mere paper-cuts on the orders of the traitor, Krafft.
No, our enemy is Time itself. Even now, the so-called Allies are gathering an invasion force to retake Europe.
This we cannot allow. The army of the thousand-year Reich must rise completely to secure what is rightly ours.
Until then, redouble your efforts. And be careful. Krafft’s commandos strike everywhere we work.
Take appropriate precautions and stay on task. The future of the Reich depends on you.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_intr/zm_cmcp_intr_krft_: The Nazis dream of a thousand-year Reich, but in truth they are already dead.
Their war machine shattered in Stalingrad, but their evil regime staggers on, desperate to snatch victory from the jaws of defeat.
A special battalion of SS troops scoured the globe for a supernatural means to win the war.
They were led by the most dangerous man I ever met...
Oberführer Wolfram Von List. It was he who destroyed my life... and cost me my soul.
Von List gathered experts from across the Reich -- archaeologists, explorers, historians...
...and authorities on the occult -- like myself.
We were forced to help them loot sacred antiquities.
But none of the relics we found gave Von List the power he craved.
Then something happened in Poland that changed everything.
Another Nazi attempt to alter the course of the war...
...somehow weakened the barrier between this world and the next...
...unleashing the forces of Darkness.
Many miles away, five of our artifacts suddenly... awakened.
Ancient spirits -- “demons” if you will -- beckoned from these otherworldly relics...
...whispering a promise of power.
And, of course, Von List accepted.
He now has the power to raise the dead -- and a plan to take back everything the Nazis lost.
All the troops he will ever require lie frozen in the mass graves of the Eastern Front.
To stop his unholy army, I must find allies...
...or the thousand-year Reich will consume us all.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_kral/zm_cmcp_kral_krft_: Professor Gabriel Krafft, Eleventh of March, 1944. I am creating a record of my involvement with the SS unit Die Wahrheit, as this may one day be called into question. And I probably won’t be around to explain myself.
In early September of 1939, I was in my office at the University of Leipzig with my assistant, Franz. We were translating an ancient Sumerian scroll when a man in walked in unannounced.
He said I must immediately tender my resignation, pack a suitcase, and depart for an overseas trip as an advisor to the SS battalion Die Wahrheit.
That was the first time I met Oberführer Wolfram Von List. All I saw was a uniform and a perfect haircut. I had no idea what lay behind those icy blue eyes.
I actually laughed. I had heard of his battalion, whose name perversely means “the Truth.”
They raided antiquities around the world, looking for evidence to support their belief in an Aryan “master race.”
I waved him away, saying I had no desire to help Reichsführer Himmler twist history to fit the Nazi narrative.
Von List calmly drew and shot poor Franz in the head. His voice was perfectly calm. “Do I have your attention now, Herr Professor?”
Gabriel Krafft, audio memoir, part two. After shooting my assistant, Von List had me dragged me out of Leipzig University and thrown in an SS prison.
There were a dozen other experts already there, “recruited” from museums and universities across the Reich to assist the SS unit, Die Wahrheit.
They were explorers, historians, archaeologists, and so on. Many looked beaten. All looked frightened.
Hung on the wall was a map of the world with notes and drawings next to different locations. Things like “the Grail” and “Thor’s hammer.” “Atlantis” and “Shangri-La.”
We wondered if this was a joke. But when Von List arrived, he was dead serious.
The Oberführer ordered us to help his troops find the places on that map and retrieve those relics. It made no difference that they did not exist. We would deliver them, or else.
The others agreed and filed out to do his bidding. They were not stupid men. I alone defied Von List.
I said, "I know what you Nazis are doing. I’ve seen friends and neighbors taken away. I’ve heard what happens at your camps. And I would rather die than help you.”
Von List showed a flash of anger... and then he smiled. He was amused I actually thought I had a say in my own fate.
Krafft, entry number three. I was surprised Von List did not shoot me. I had refused to serve him. Twice.
Instead, he sent his men to my home. They broke down the door and took my spouse to an SS interrogation chamber.
I had put my values and dignity ahead of my own life. So Von List made someone else pay for my stubbornness.
Should I refuse to help Die Wahrheit, or drag my feet in any way, the love of my life would be slowly tortured to death.
Of course, I complied. How could I do otherwise? But I also made a silent promise to myself.
I would learn of Die Wahrheit’s secrets. If we found anything of real value, I would turn it against them.
Somehow, I would destroy Von List and his Nazi thugs from within.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_krrt/zm_cmcp_krrt_krft_: *clears throat* Greetings. I am Professor Gabriel Krafft. I presume you came in response to my message? The one I radioed just before the containment spell went up?
I... had hoped for a larger fighting force, but I already see you are no ordinary soldiers. Perhaps you will be enough, but we have quite a challenge ahead.
You see, our mission is to stop the man responsible for the nightmare unfolding all around you.
The commanding officer of the SS battalion Die Wahrheit. The murderer who has now bonded with an ancient evil.
Oberführer Wolfram Von List. Left unchecked, he will single-handedly win the war for the Nazis. That may sound preposterous, but I assure you it is true.
In any case, thanks to the containment spell we are cut off from the outside world, unable to summon reinforcements or further warn your superiors.
Success or failure is solely up to us.
Krafft to Special Forces team. We should talk about the entities you bonded with. You must have so many questions.
Fortunately, I taught demonology at the University of Leipzig. I have more than a passing familiarity with your otherworldly “partners.”

Since 1939, I was forced to work for Von List and his Die Wahrheit thugs. I helped them recover five ancient artifacts. As it turned out, these were conduits to supernatural beings from a place called the Dark Aether.
The most powerful among them, Kortifex the Deathless, is in league with Oberführer Von List. The demons inhabiting you are his sworn enemies.
I shall do all I can to help you take advantage of their gifts without being... corrupted by their influence.
Then again, this is a time for uneasy alliances. Who would ever have imagined Churchill and Stalin joining forces? “Better the devil you know,” as they say...
So, for now, we work toward a common purpose with your “demons.” They need to stop Kortifex, we need to stop Von List. Win or lose, we must do this together.
Krafft here. As you well know, this area is swarming with revenants. I just want to reassure you that I myself am quite safe for the moment.
Since the day the artifacts awoke, Von List kept me by his side. After all, I’m as close as there is to an expert on the entity dwelling within him.
When we arrived here in Stalingrad it took the locals by surprise. The last thing they expected was the Nazis to return.
But Von List had been here when the Germans surrendered. He wants to turn the site of their greatest loss into the source of Nazi victory.
To do this, he will raise an army of revenants from the millions who perished on the Eastern Front. But to accomplish such a feat, Kortifex must first build up his strength.
Von List locked me in this room with my books and a radio. I watched from my window as he called upon Kortifex to seal off this part of the city. And I knew I had to act.
Once I radioed for help, I used what I learned from the Tome of Rituals. The rune magic in its pages sealed this room.
Of course, I have no idea how to undo the spell. But, for now, neither Von List nor his revenants can touch me here.
And now that you have responded to my cry for help, we must work together. We must stall their progress and gather information on Die Wahrheit’s activities.
I will continue to advise you while I formulate a plan to stop them once and for all. Until then, keep fighting, my champions. We must strengthen your demons if we have any hope of winning.
This is Krafft, with some background on the artifacts you carry.
They were used by ancient priests and sorcerers in places as far-flung as the Yucatan and the islands of Japan.
They were said to commune with “angels” and summon “demons.”
But when we unearthed these artifacts, we were faced with a mystery.
There were strange design details, markings and materials that simply did not fit the cultures that claimed them.
These objects were anomalies. Anachronisms. They did not belong in those settings. They were... alien.
I have since confirmed the artifacts were created in the Dark Aether dimension.
They were cast by inhuman hands, in forms meant to appeal to human aesthetics. Small wonder they got the details wrong.
They allowed beings who could not come here physically to visit as spirits and bond with mortal flesh.
Some, like Kortifex, were cruel and controlling. Others, like Bellekar, were kind and benevolent.
Alas, these relics became their prisons. Each demon is now trapped like the proverbial genie in a lamp.
Safeguard your artifacts. Study them. Learn to unlock their powers.
Just don’t try to sell them. Any appraiser worth his salt would dismiss them as forgeries. And in a sense, they would be right.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_obdm/zm_cmcp_obdm_dnrt_: “Augmentors.” I shall take us to them, that you may cast them back to the Dark Aether.
Kortifex must be breeding Augmentors. We must dispatch them immediately.
There must be Augmentors hidden around here somewhere. I shall take us to them.
Sounds like the work of Augmentors. I can locate them. The rest is up to you.
When Norticus the Conqueror leads an army, the outcome is never in doubt.
Where others falter, Norticus finds victory. The humans helped, too.
I always win, professor. Feel free to bask in my glory.
My soldiers did as I told them. So, yes, success is ours.
These humans proved themselves worthy of my leadership.
Yes, professor, we did what we set out to do.
The new soldiers of Norticus have much to be proud of today.
It is always a pleasure denying Kortifex what he wants.
My troops are gaining ground, Kortifex.
You see, Kortifex? My mortals are dominating your fleshbags.
Keep this up, soldiers of Norticus, and victory is ours.
We now dominate the battlefield. Keep it that way!
I love this feeling -- when the tide of battle turns in my favor.
Soldiers of Norticus, you are proving your worth.
We have opened up a second front.
Another Augmentor is ours to banish.
See that, Kortifex? Another rune we’ll take from you.
Yes! Take even more ground from the enemy!
Yes! This is how victories are forged.
Excellent! Now hold those prizes.
Look for runes where the Augmentors burrow. Capture and hold them until that ground is yours.
There are runes where they burrow. Occupy them until the Augmentors are dispelled.
You must capture any rune you can stand on, and send the Augmentors back from whence they came.
Look for runes. Beneath them lie the Augmentors. Hold that ground long enough, and back they go to the Dark Aether.
Spare us your bluster, Kortifex! My soldiers will take your ground, one rune at a time.
Ignore Kortifex. Just occupy the runes until his Augmentors are gone.
Kortifex fears you -- and he should. Capture his runes and break his hold on this place.
Focus on your mission. Capture each rune and hold your ground. Prove yourselves to me.
Huzzah! Sweet victory! I accept nothing less.
Not bad, for mortals. Not bad at all.
Kortifex’s weapons are dispelled to the Dark Aether. I salute you.
Mission accomplished. You rid us of the Augmentors.
Without his Augmentors, our enemy is weakened. Splendid.
Taking ground and holding it is what a soldier does.
A worthy effort, soldiers of Norticus.
I used Augmentors in past campaigns. They are powerful magic.
When I commanded the Night Legions, we used Augmentors to win battles.
Augmentors were created during the Netherwars. They can be hard to dispel.
Augmentors are exceedingly rare. How does Kortifex summon them?
Find the runes. Capture the runes. Dispel the Augmentors. Go!
You know what to do. Capture and hold those runes.
Show some initiative and stand your ground.
Find and capture those runes. Rid us of the Augmentors.
The Augmentors have to go. Hold the ground above them.
Our unseen targets are marked by runes. Take them.
Seize their weak spots. Basic tactics -- tried and true.
Find the runes. Occupy them till the Augmentors are gone.
Now show me I’m not wasting my genius on half-wits!
Sound the horn! Unsheathe your weapons! It’s time to kill or die!
Once again we plunge into battle. Only now are we truly alive...
These are the moments I live for. Death and glory lie ahead...
Norticus the Conqueror leads you into battle. The honor is yours.
Follow my orders and victory is assured.
Keep your wits and fight like demons.
This is between me and Kortifex -- but you will play your part.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_obdm/zm_cmcp_obdm_krft_: We have a problem: worm-creatures from the Dark Aether are corrupting our battleground.
Krafft to Special Forces team: Von List has acquired more Augmentors.
The containment spell that traps us here is being strengthened by Augmentor worms.
Now hear this: the barrier spell of Kortifex is strengthening. Norticus will show you the source.
Go with Norticus. You must weaken the barrier spell by cleansing Control Runes.
Norticus will show you how to cleanse Kortifex’s stain on our lands.
Norticus, strike a blow against Kortifex.
Stop Kortifex’s worms from strengthening his barrier spell.
Well? Did you undo their... desecration?
Those worms leave an unholy stain. Did you stop them?
Krafft here. The Augmentors are gone, yes?
Did it work? Did you cleanse their corruption?
Tell me we are rid of the Augmentors’ stain.
Whatever Kortifex plans with those worms, did you stop him for now?
Despite those foul Augmentors, it looks like your raid was a success.
I worry those worms are polluting our world. Did you succeed?
Beware! The Augmentors are summoning more revenants!
Remember: the more ground you cleanse, the less they can throw at you.
Hurry! Cleanse more runes and you’ll have less to fight.
Look out! More enemies arrive to protect the Control Runes!
Eliminate the Augmentor worms. Cleanse their corruption.
Cleanse those Control Runes quickly, before the worms call down more revenants.
Banish as many Augmentors as you can. They will summon reinforcements.
I am counting on you to cleanse that ground and eliminate the threat.
Kortifex’s “Augmentor” worms lurk beneath you. They eat dimensional energies and befoul our world.
Find the “Augmentors” corrupting that area. Send them back to the Dark Aether.
That area is infested with Augmentor worms. They corrupt the ground you stand on.
Kortifex released “Augmentor worms” to empower his containment spell. Cleanse the area -- quickly.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_obdm/zm_cmcp_obdm_krtx_: That is the last Control Rune you shall ever cleanse! Kill them, my revenants!
I’ll kill your red-bloods, Norticus -- then feed you to my Augmentors.
You want that rune, humans? You can choke on it!
Push them back, my puppets. Kill these upstarts!
Another Control Rune gone? Damn you!
Fight back, Augmentors! Unleash Hell itself!
The Augmentors are mine! Mine!
You trained them well, Norticus, but they are only human.
What have you done to my Augmentor? You will die screaming for this!
Fight harder, revenants! I will brook no further losses.
You may have banished an Augmentor, but your luck is running out.
Control Runes vanishing. Augmentors cleansed. This has to stop!
You’ve been lucky so far, but my puppets will stop you.
You have cost me an Augmentor. Now you will pay the price.
Stinking red-bloods, why won’t you die?!
Enough of this cleansing! I will have no more of you!
General Norticus, spare me your bile.
This is humiliating. I will not be bested by a traitor and his mortal lackeys!
You think the worm has turned, Norticus? It will feast on your corpse!
Why do you fight for him, humans? Help Von List and your future is assured.
Where did you find these fighters, Norticus? You do not deserve them!
Damn you, mortals! I execute thieves!
Stop taking my Augmentors!
Red-blood humans, you’ll pay dearly for that loss!
Did you think this would be easy? Yield, or die.
Take that ground back, my revenants. Take their lives as well.
Your soldiers will fall, Norticus. So swears Kortifex the Deathless!
Retreat, humans. Or drown beneath a tide of rotting flesh!
Take it back, my children. Do not give up ground!
No, humans. My puppets will bury you!
You have angered my Augmentors. Bad mistake.
You will have to fight for every inch of ground here.
General Norticus! I see you found new soldiers. Or should I say fresh meat?
Norticus the traitor. Once again you dare defy me.
Believe me, humans, I have more Augmentors than you can possibly cleanse.
Greetings, Norticus. I look forward to slaying your new “army.”
You strike at my Augmentors? You will find they strike back harder...
Augmentors -- the enemy has come. Keep them off your Control Runes.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_obex/zm_cmcp_obex_blkr_: You’re getting there... just keep striking them down.
Take heart, soldiers. Your efforts will soon open the Rift.
Be steadfast. The Rift Portal comes soon.
If you choose to withdraw from battle, there’s a Runegate in the square.
That Runegate summons a Rift Portal. Get inside and you’re safe.
I sense the Rift Portal. Get to it now!
We have to go! The Rift Portal is here.
Rift Portal’s open. Run to it!
Be vigilant for the Rift Portal. It’s your sanctuary.
The Rift Portal opens once you spill enough blood.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_obex/zm_cmcp_obex_dnrt_: Stay strong! The Rift Portal opens soon.
Clear out these abominations! It hastens the portal’s approach.
I sense the Rift Portal. It will not be long...
Should you need a respite from combat, use the Runegate in the town square.
That one summons a Rift Portal. Once inside it, you can rest.
The Rift Portal arrived. Get to it quickly!
Retreat to the Rift Portal! Now!
The portal just opened. Withdraw immediately!
A Rift Portal will open soon. Get to it immediately.
You have to slay enemies to make the portal appear.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_obex/zm_cmcp_obex_dnvk_: Fight on! Won’t be long till the Portal appears.
Keep spilling blood! The Rift will open!
Give them no quarter! The more you drop, the sooner we go!
For a tactical retreat, go to the Runegate in the public square.
When triggered, a Rift Portal will come. That’s your bunker till you fight again.
Rift Portal’s here. Sound the retreat!
Head for the portal! Move, move move!
When the rift portal arrives, run to it.
The quicker you kill them, the sooner the portal comes.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_obex/zm_cmcp_obex_dsrx_: You’re doing well, my plaything. The Rift will soon appear.
You are ruthless! You’ll have that portal here in no time!
Don’t let up. I can feel the Rift Portal taking form...
Once you’ve had enough fighting, try the Runegate near the fountain.
Use it to call a Rift Portal -- your refuge from the revenants.
That’s enough! Head for the portal!
The Rift just opened. Time to go!
When the Rift Portal opens, get there quick as you can.
Speed the rift -- strike down these mindless things.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_obex/zm_cmcp_obex_krft_: You made it! Now shelter in that portal until we fight again.
I knew you would make it to safety. What a relief!
You had me so worried! Thank heavens you are safe -- for now.
You’re safe! Fantastisch! Rest now. We live to fight another day.
The portal will only open if you sacrifice enough revenants.
Strike them down, my allies. Only their deaths can summon the portal.
You must slay revenants to open the Rift Portal. Hurry!
Kill as many as you can! Their sacrifice will open the portal.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_obex/zm_cmcp_obex_vlst_: Professor, your soldiers tire of fighting. My revenants do not.
Nein, Special Forces, Nein. I will not let you rest.
Intruders, you are not going anywhere. My army won’t let you.
Are you leaving without saying goodbye? I don’t think so...
Attack them! No rest for the weak!
Your soldiers are cowards, Professor. Just like you.
Die Wahrheit gives no man the easy way out!
Sounding the retreat, are we? I am not finished with you yet.
You cannot strike at me and expect to just walk away.
All my soldiers have standing orders: no prisoners, no retreats.
You will not escape what you started. Revenants, drag them down!
Watch this, Krafft. Your soldiers are tired. I’ll put them to rest.
Only cowards run from battle. And leave their backs exposed.
You’ll be torn to pieces long before you can escape.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_obhb/zm_cmcp_obhb_blkr_: They call that the Altar of Covenants. Don’t be scared, just buy what it offers.
Make a deal -- a covenant -- with that altar. You won’t regret it.
That altar could be your best friend. Just see what you can get from it.
How does that box work? No idea. It is an altogether different magic.
That box is a wellspring of firearms.
One day I’ll find out who created that box.
We need you in peak condition. A drink from that fountain will help.
That’s demon blood in that fountain. A taste will make you strong.
You may not like the flavor, but the power in that fountain could save your life.
The mind is the greatest weapon.
So you want to take on Kortifex? I can teach you how.
Eyes open, mind sharp.
Our foe is Kortifex, Lord of the Dark Aether. Prepare to be tested.
Human warfare fascinates me. Show me more.
Know your enemy and you cannot lose.
Warfare is a science... and an art.
Bellekar the Warlock, at your service.
The Pack-a-Punch device. Turns any weapon into something glorious.
That strange little furnace is priceless. It fills weapons with magic fire.
Pack-a-Punch. Science or magic? Perhaps a bit of both.
The Tome of Rituals. Dark Aether secrets, but written by human hands.
The abilities I grant you can be enhanced. That book will show you how.
Professor Krafft helped assemble that book -- a feat few mortals could achieve.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_obhb/zm_cmcp_obhb_dnrt_: The Altar of Covenants. Source of much that can elevate your prowess.
Go to that altar if you want help in battle.
Make a covenant with the altar, come away a better soldier.
That casket is a source of prime weaponry.
You can better arm yourself from that box.
The Box of Mystery. Even we do not know from whence it came.
Demon blood flows from that font. Drink deep of our power.
There is power in that fountain. If you can stomach it.
Grab a goblet and taste of that fountain. You need its strength.
Heed my commands and victory will follow.
I am Norticus the Conqueror. You are my sword and shield.
I commanded the Night Legions. Prove yourself worthy.
I once led the armies of Kortifex the Deathless. Now, his sworn enemy.
We are joined now, mortal. But I give the commands.
I was known as the Conqueror long before your world existed.
I am Kortifex’s oldest foe. Let us bring him to ruin.
You have joined yourself to the Conqueror. Glory awaits us.
This machine is like a magic forge. Give it your weapon and see what I mean.
Another strange artifact from the Dark Aether. It can turn bullets to thunderbolts.
If you wish to survive the day, get acquainted with this device.
That book can unlock more of my powers.
That book knows things -- like how to unleash my abilities.
The Tome of Rituals. Use it to deepen the bond between us. For fighting.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_obhb/zm_cmcp_obhb_dnvk_: Behold the Altar of Covenants. It can better equip you for battle.
Strike a covenant with that altar and you could be... slightly less useless.
A true warrior knows the value of that altar. Get familiar with it.
That box has weapons, but it is like a game of chance.
That mysterious box conjures excellent weapons.
Don’t know how it works. Don’t care. That box is your quartermaster.
Drink the blood of demons and fight like one of us.
Demon blood. It does a body... well, not “good.” But drink it, anyway.
See that fountain? Have a taste of demon blood.
I will forge you into a true warrior.
I am Inviktor the Destroyer, master of the front lines.
You’ll have my respect when you can fight like a demon.
Today we fight Kortifex the Deathless. Let’s bring him to his knees.
So, it is you I must train? Hrr. I’ve made do with less...
You march with Inviktor against the mighty Kortifex. Gird your loins.
I am War.
Your ancestors worshipped me. I taught them to make war.
The forge of firearms. Be thankful this one is here.
That mechanism adds punch to your weapons. Try it.
I wish I knew who made this machine. Surely a genius at the forge.
I hate books. But that one can unlock my true strength.
See it? The Tome of Rituals. Crack it open and plumb the depths of power.
I can do much more for you, human. That book can show you how.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_obhb/zm_cmcp_obhb_dsrx_: The Altar of Covenants. How lovely. You should see what you can gain from it.
That altar is not for praying. But it is for "preying". See what I did there?
Want to fight like a champion? See what the Altar of Covenants can do for you.
The Mystery Box. Try it -- it’s fun!
Ah, the gun-box. I always wanted to climb inside and surprise its next customer.
Need a gun? That’s your box.
Oh, plaything, if it’s power you thirst for, try that fountain.
I bet you’re parched. Slake your thirst from that fountain. Trust me.
Dip a goblet in that fountain. We need to put some spring in your step.
Hello, plaything. Let’s have some fun.
You want to stir up trouble? You picked the right partner.
I’m Saraxis the Shadow. You’ll be safe enough with me.
I know what you are capable of... even if you don’t.
We face Kortifex the Deathless. When you pick an enemy you don’t fool around.
Just think of me as that little devil on your shoulder.
I’ve had many names among your kind. You can call me Saraxis.
Your ancestors feared me. I can’t imagine why.
I used to see these scattered around the Dark Aether. No idea where they came from.
“Pack-a-Punch.” Such a whimsical name.
This little forge-thing can make your weapons roar.
That book is alive with forbidden knowledge. You’ve only scratched the surface of my power.
The Tome of Rituals can make me stronger. Help me help you.
If you want to get more out of our... partnership, that book is what you need.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_obhb/zm_cmcp_obhb_krft_: The crafting table. Turn your salvage into something useful.
That table can transform trash into treasure. Get busy, my friend.
The scrap you gather can create marvels. Give it a try.
That will serve you well in battle.
Ah. The tools of your trade.
The next best thing to factory made.
Ingenious. Well done.
I am not a fighting man, but I would want that.
Your mechanical skills are impressive.
Now you are ready, ja?
May it help you prevail.
Nice. Were you a craftsman before the war?
Beware! A Sturmkrieger is near you. And it is heavily armed.
Do you see the Sturmkrieger? Big. Tough. And they shoot back.
A Sturmkrieger approaches. Hard to kill and armed to the teeth.
I call the big ones “Sturmkriegers.” They know how to shoot!
Do not delay, my friends. Enter a portal.
Remember the portals? Our mission awaits.
Enter a portal. There is much to be done.
I do not mean to nag, but you really should enter a portal soon.
Keep checking the Altar of Covenants. It’s offerings improve.
Remember, my allies: the Altar of Covenants updates what it sells.
New covenants await at the altar. See for yourself.
Now would be a good time to inspect the Altar’s new covenants.
Well done! But there are more to bring down.
That barrier’s down. Excellent. Now do it again.
You’re back. Splendid! Now on to the next one.
Von List won’t be happy about that. Think you can do it again?
That’s one obstruction eliminated. Take down the others.
A fine start! Now open the next one.
Wunderbar, my friends. On to next blockage.
You are in fine form today. Can you take down another?
Keep fighting, my champions. Clear every obstruction.
Outstanding work. Keep at it until this battleground is open.
Von List must be worried now. Don’t stop till his barriers are gone.
Onward, my allies. Take another one down.
This is Krafft. You have another blockage to clear.
Almost there. Keep clearing obstructions.
See that, Von List? My allies are dismantling your work.
Fantastisch. Now take down another.
Another one cleared. Von List will be furious!
The more freely you can move, the more you’ll find to empower you.
So far, so good. Von List underestimates you.
Von List wants to keep you from sources of power. Don’t let him.
Starting to feel some elbow room out there, aren’t you?
Explore the areas you open up. Use every means to fortify yourself.
Another obstruction removed. The Oberführer must be beside himself.
Look around you! See what you’ve done to their little blockade?
Once you have had your fill of fighting, there is a way to safely withdraw.
Krafft here. You can now exfiltrate from this place, should you need to.
Good progress. Now you can now also safely depart, if necessary.
Be advised, you can now summon a rift portal to exit the battle. Your demons will explain it all.
Don’t stop now. But if you must retreat, there is now a way to exit the battle.
Special Forces: when you leave the battle -- I believe you call it “exfil”? That option is now open.
You are unstoppable! But should you choose to rest, summon a rift portal. More on that later.
You’ve hardly broken a sweat. But if you must withdraw, there is a way.
Careful. There is an explosive revenant in your vicinity.
The cry of the Boom-Schreier. Do not let it get too close.
I hear a Boom-Schreier. Shoot it before it blows up in your face!
I call the screamers “Boom-Schreiers.” Emphasis on the “boom.”
Krafft to Special Forces. Von List has you boxed in. Pick an obstacle and get to work.
This is professor Krafft. Open all barriers so we can stop Colonel Von List.
Start opening obstructions. Your demon “partners” will assist you.
You are just in time! Open all the blockades so we can take the fight to Von List.
My champions, we have work to do. Pick an obstruction and do what you do best.
Special Forces, this is Krafft. Start taking down barriers. You need room to maneuver.
Professor Krafft here. Several barriers stand between you and our mission. Take them all down.
Oberfuhrer Von List blockaded this area to box you in. Clear his barriers and give him Hell.
Go into those portals and win corrupted hearts. You’ll see what I mean...
Enter the portals and win black hearts -- the coin of this dark realm.
Defeat what lies beyond these portals to win corrupted hearts. You will need them.
Go through portals, return with black hearts. Use them to purchase power.
The portals lead to challenges. Demon hearts are your reward. Go get them.
Through those portals lies all you require. But you must take it.
Win the dark hearts on the far side of those portals. They are priceless.
Beyond those portals are rewards you will need. Get them at once!
Krafft to Special Forces. Von List now wields the powers of Kortifex. To stop him, you must take down his barriers. The Dark Aether entities from your artifacts will help. They hate Kortifex, too.
This is professor Krafft. Open all barriers so we can stop Oberführer Von List. He has bonded with Kortifex, the enemy of the demons you bonded with.

Professor Krafft here. Thank you for coming to my assistance. Take down Von List’s barriers. You will need your Dark Aether “partners” to counter the powers the Oberfuhrer gained from their enemy, Kortifex.
Krafft to Special Forces. You are just in time. Clear the blockades so we can take the fight to Von List. He wields the powers of Kortifex, ancient enemy of the demons you bonded with.
My rescuers, you are here! This is professor Krafft. Your artifacts show that you bonded with powerful entities, but so has Von List. Clear out his obstacles -- your Dark Aether partners will help.

Special Forces, this is Krafft. You answered my call. Those artifacts bonded you with Dark Aether entities. Work with them to take down Von List’s barriers. They hate his “partner” Kortifex as much as we hate Nazis.
Professor Krafft here. Several barriers stand between you and our mission. Von List used Kortifex’s power to create them. Work with your Dark Aether partners to take them all down.

Allied soldiers, this is professor Krafft. Oberführer Von List and his demon Kortifex blockaded this area. The demons you bonded with will help you break free. Only then can we stop Von List’s master plan.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_obhb/zm_cmcp_obhb_krtx_: Think you can pass here unhindered? Think again...
Mortal fools, you came a long way just to die.
They seek battle, my puppets. Give it to them!
You test my patience, mortals. Now pay the price!
What will it take to be rid of you red-bloods?!
They walk amongst you, my puppets. Tear them to pieces!
Your presence here offends me, red-bloods. Time to die...
You tested my strength -- and paid the price.
Witless mortals, you never stood a chance.
You learned the hard way: never cross Kortifex.
Kortifex the Deathless cannot be beaten.
Your pathetic resistance is crushed beneath my heel.
I wield power beyond your understanding.  [laughs]
Your corpses will answer my orders now.
Death comes to all who oppose mighty Kortifex.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_obhb/zm_cmcp_obhb_vlst_: Professor, it is time to bid your toy soldiers auf wiedersehen.
I tire of your meddling. Time for you to die.
Revenants! Rid me of these tiresome fools.
You have picked a fight you cannot win.
This is Die Wahrheit territory. Trespassers will be executed.
What are you looking for, soldiers? Here you will find only death.
You are fools to do Krafft’s bidding. But once you are dead, you will answer my commands.
We have unwanted visitors. Eliminate them.
If it’s trouble you want, I’ll give you more than you can handle.
Watch, Herr Professor. Watch your friends perish!
The thousand-year Reich is now all but assured.
You took on Die Wahrheit, but The Truth always wins.
This is what happens when you stand in the way of Wolfram Von List.
Professor Krafft only led you to your doom.
Krafft, are you watching? Your “champions” are mine now!
Your demons could not save you. And now your nations will fall.
You took orders from a bookworm! What did you expect would happen?!
“Special Forces”? You were nothing against Die Warheit and an army of dead men.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_obhb/zm_zohs_hbsk_krtx_: Those who dare defy me always fail in the end.
I am Kortifex the Deathless. You... are nothing.
Do you tire of defeat? I never tire of victory.
You failed. You red-bloods always fail.
Your defeat was only a matter of time.
You took sides with my betrayers. A coward’s death for you.
You were fools to ever think you could defy me.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_obhb/zm_zohs_hbsk_vlst_: You never realized how powerful I am -- or will become.
Soon, the rest of your wretched armies will join you in death.
I am Wolfram Von List, and I am the instrument of your destruction.
Alas, Herr Professor, your great experiment is over.
I don’t know who disgusts me more -- Krafft, or you who died for him.
All you fought for, all you believed in -- ultimately meaningless.
First you fall. Then your homelands.
No one will mourn your wasted lives. No one.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_obhd/zm_cmcp_obhd_dnvk_: March, soldier. Find the right place for me to open a portal.
I can take us to his so-called troops, but we must find a point of departure...
I can send you there briefly, but only where the veil between worlds is thin.
Ready to deploy? Let’s find the right “insertion point.”
This is the place. The veil is thin here.
I can open the portal here. Make ready.
Signal when you are ready, and I’ll open the portal.
We’re close. I’ll part the veil at your signal.
That was... satisfactory. Perhaps you will end Von List. Perhaps.
You’re alive. That’s a win.
I am... pleased with your peformance. Improve on it next time.
You have much to learn, but you hurt Kortifex, and that is enough.
That will do, mortals. That will do.
Hrmph. Next time kill more of them.
Good. I’ll make real soldiers of you yet.
You live to fight again. That is all you can ask for.
I can only keep you here a short time, so spend it laying waste to the enemy!
I’ll keep you there until my strength gives out.
Your raid must be brief. Make it fruitful.
I cannot keep you there long. Make it painful for your foes.
He fears you. Can you hear it? Just stay alive and mow them down.
I seldom feel anything for humans. But that Von List is worthy of contempt.
Look alive, mortals! The battle is about to be joined.
Empty threats. Kill his puppets and let us be done with this.
Never mind Kortifex, just get on with the killing.
Kortifex the Deathless. I would cut out his heart if he had one.
Very interesting. Now shut up. There’s killing to be done.
Kortifex is a pompous fool. Make him hurt.
You know what to do. Kill, kill, KILL!!
You are there for one reason: wholesale slaughter.
Kill them all. I’ll keep you there as long as I can.
The mission is simple: Kill the enemy. A lot.
Whatever comes at you, send it back to Hell.
You are there to kill the enemy. Hope you brought enough bullets.
If it moans and screams and attacks you, destroy it. Understood?
Every corpse you destroy is a little slice of Kortifex. Bleed him dry.
This won’t be complicated. Just kill anything that moves.
Go! Take them by surprise!
I shall keep you there as long as I can...
The way is clear! Show no mercy!
Seek and destroy. It’s as simple as that.
The time has come to prove your worth.
Just make sure you are the last ones standing.
Step through, humans. Blood and glory await.
Fight on! Each creature you kill bleeds the strength from the enemy.
You’re still alive? I'm impressed!
More victims coming. Show them the error of their ways.
Brace yourselves, human. Here come fresh troops.
Gird your loins, mortals! The battle rages on!
More enemies, more kills, more glory!
Strike down his revenants. Make Kortifex suffer!
Here comes more chances to prove yourselves, humans.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_obhd/zm_cmcp_obhd_krft_: This is a war of attrition, my allies. Take the fight to the enemy.
Krafft to Special Forces: we have a chance to go on the offensive.
My allies, I see an opportunity to hit Von List... “where it counts.”
Krafft here. Let’s go give Kortifex the death of a thousand cuts.
Kill the enemy. Inviktor will open the way.
Go on the attack. Inviktor will guide you.
Time for a surprise attack.
Strike down all revenants.
Splendid work, my allies. We are one step closer to being free.
You struck a blow, and I know Von List felt it. It is what he deserves.
Von List will not forgive this. Then again, to Hell with him.
My friends, if Kortifex can weaken, he can be beaten. Well done.
Each strike like this buys us time. You have my gratitude.
Another small victory. Bravo, my friends.
You see, Von List? Evil cannot prevail!
Keep this up, my friends, and victory is ours.
Take the fight to Von List! Weaken his forces by killing as many as you can.
This is Krafft. We are on the offensive. Kill anything that moves!
Weaken the Oberführer’s army. Kill every revenant you see!
Krafft to Special Forces: annihilate the undead.
Kortifex puts his power into every revenant. Kill them and he weakens.
Von List calls the shots, but his demon empowers his army. Kill them and his power ebbs.
Each revenant carries a bit of Kortifex’s magic. Kill them and you weaken the demon.
Killing revenants doesn’t just deplete Von List’s forces. It drains his demon, Kortifex.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_obhd/zm_cmcp_obhd_krtx_: Upstart mortals! You cannot win! Kill them, my children! *roars*
You think you are bleeding me? It is I who will feast on your blood!
Rise, soldiers! Let them taste my hatred!
This sacrilege must end! You shall not leave here alive!
Kill my soldiers again and again. They only need to kill you once.
Wear them down, revenants! Give them no quarter!
You will die here, red-bloods. You are only human.
Strike my soldiers down and more will take their place.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_obhd/zm_cmcp_obhd_vlst_: Damn you all! Kortifex must rest --  for now -- but I will have revenge.
You got lucky today. But you will fall -- and soon. I swear it.
You think you won something? Only my undying hatred.
You have made a blood enemy of Oberführer Wolfram Von List. Good luck with that.
One of these times you will bite off more than you can chew.
Try that again. I promise it will not go as well for you.
So you cost me a handful of soldiers. I have millions more. Millions!
Where did you find these soldiers, Krafft? They are better than you deserve.
Come to kill my soldiers? Ha, ha! You cannot withstand their onslaught.
You poor, stupid men. Professor Krafft has sent you to your deaths.
Intruders! I will crush you with sheer numbers.
So you’ve come here to die? My legions will devour you.
Destroy the intruders. My plans will not be thwarted!
Rise, revenants! Dinner is served.
I shall enjoy watching you die. It will break the professor’s degenerate heart.
Fools! You are but sheep in the lion’s den!
Come looking for a fight? You will get one.
Oh, you poor, lost soldiers. You have stepped into the meat grinder.
Krafft, you have sent your soldiers on their final mission!
Now, my soldiers! Tear them to shreds!
subtitle_zm_cmcp_obof/zm_cmcp_obof_blkr_: Almost there. The revenant head can sense its destination.
You’re making good progress. Bellekar believes in you.
Kortifex is nervous. His enemies will know where to find him.
Keep going. The orb will soon cross over.
Battle on, my pupils! Your path is nearly complete.
Protect that orb! Our message must get through.
Soon, Kortifex, everyone back home will know what you are up to.
The orb says it’s about to cross over. Keep going!
I can take us to the place where our “emissary” awaits.
Once we go through a portal, I’ll explain in greater detail.
There are many who would help us. Let’s find a portal and you’ll see.
I’ll open a portal so you can send our cry for help.
I am ready to take us to the orb. Shall we...?
The portal is near. We’ll go at your signal.
Are you ready? I’ll open a portal.
The orb awaits. Ready yourselves.
It may take time, but someone will respond.
If we do that often enough, a friend will come to our aid.
This time, help will come. I know it.
And now to make another orb.
Someone will answer. They all have scores to settle with Kortifex.
May this one finally summon my allies.
It is not weakness to ask for help. It is wisdom.
The signal is sent. Answer the call, old friends.
Ensure it makes contact with my allies in the Dark Aether.
It carries a message to my allies in the Dark Aether. Make sure it gets through.
We seek aid from old friends in the Dark Aether.
The head in that orb carries a message to my allies back home.
Forget Kortifex. Keep pace with the orb -- kill anything that moves.
This will work. Stay close to the orb. Complete its journey.
Kortifex underestimates us. Escort the orb and prove him wrong.
Just make sure the orb delivers its message. Many back home would gladly fight Kortifex.
Charmingly gruesome, is it not? Escort it, and protect yourselves.
Don’t sell yourself short, Professor. This is a brilliant idea.
For a demonologist, Krafft has a decent grasp of engineering.
I learn as much from the Professor as he does from me. Give his orb a good send off.
Escort the orb. It will contact my allies in the Dark Aether.
The orb has a message to deliver. Stay close and see it off.
We seek help from the Dark Aether. Ensure the orb sends its message.
The orb carries a message for the Dark Aether. Stay close and protect it.
The orb must make it to the Dark Aether. Safeguard it until it does.
Guard the orb. Keep our enemies away from it.
We need help from the Dark Aether. Ensure the orb makes it through.
Accompany the orb. A lot may be riding on this.
Kortifex once ruled the Dark Aether. Many there still hold a grudge.
Kortifex has many enemies. Most were once his servants.
Since we can’t contact your armies, we must seek what help we can get.
Kortifex sees no value in allies. I, on the other hand, have many.
If we can rally support from the Dark Aether, it is worth the risk.
Messengers are vital in warfare. But they must be protected.
Ready, my pupils? We must summon reinforcements.
Another orb, another chance to gain an ally.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_obof/zm_cmcp_obof_krft_: Bellekar and I are recruiting new allies from the Dark Aether.
Krafft speaking: we need more allies. I have a plan for that.
Attention: we need to dispatch a message to the Dark Aether.
Bellekar and I have a plan to summon help.
Help us send a message to the Dark Aether.
Help Bellekar send a distress call.
We need help -- from the Dark Aether.
We have a message to send, thanks to Bellekar.
Let us hope whoever answers is not worse than Kortifex.
Soon this war will span two worlds. I suppose it already does...
“The enemy of my enemy...” I just hope the saying is true.
One day soon, Kortifex’s sins will all come home to roost.
When the invitation is a severed head, how does one RSVP?
Bellekar, I hope we know what we are doing.
Strange bedfellows. Desperate alliances. How I hate this war...
We need all the friends we can get.
Do you see a floating orb? It seeks a weak point in Kortifex’s barrier.
That floating orb will find a weak spot between dimensions. Stay close -- you will protect each other.
Follow that floating orb. It seeks a flaw in the barrier spell.
Find the floating orb and follow it closely.
Bellekar is teaching me rune magic. I even helped construct that orb.
That orb was my idea. Constructing it took Bellekar’s magic.
Bellekar and I collaborated on that orb. I’m a bit surprised it works.
I have learned a little rune magic. I even helped to make that orb.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_obof/zm_cmcp_obof_krtx_: You mortals are so easily led. And easily bled.
Bellekar lies to you, humans. The beings you summon will destroy you.
Even if you succeed, help will not come. I rule the Dark Aether!
You are on a fool’s errand. You’ll pay with your lives.
Stop! Turn back! If you send that to my realm, you know not what will answer!
Who is that orb for, Bellekar? I thought I killed all your friends.
You send a corpse’s head as your emissary? How appropriate.
This is futile. You cast a message in a bottle upon an endless sea.
Damn you! I’ll kill you long before help comes!
So you sent your message. So what? No one will answer. You are alone!
You think it a triumph to beg demons for help? You will regret it.
Let your friends come, Bellekar! None can stand against me.
You accomplished nothing. Your plea for help will fall upon deaf ears.
Hrr. Keep sending your orbs. I welcome more chances to kill you.
Bah! My allies will intercept your brain-dead messenger.
Bellekar, I will make you suffer for this!
What is inside that thing, Bellekar? The head of a revenant?
You are trying to contact my ancient enemies. I will not allow it.
How pathetic: seeking aid with the severed head of a revenant.
Bellekar the Warlock. Ever the thorn in my side.
Think, humans. Are you summoning help... or ringing a dinner bell?
How many red-bloods have you led to their deaths, Bellekar?
Red-blood soldiers, you chose the wrong side in this war.
Oh Bellekar, you love your pets too much. Now watch them die.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_obsc/zm_cmcp_obsc_dsrx_: It’s working, you clever ape. Keep feeding the Sin Eater.
Keep going, plaything. I can almost taste the feast.
More killing! More runestones! I want my power back!
You’re making progress. Mortals are always good for a game of fetch.
Ooh. Now we’re cooking...
Thanks for the runestones -- go get some more.
For me? You shouldn’t have.
Mm. That got my stomach growling...
Let us find a Sin Eater to restore our waning strength.
I’ll lead us to an obelisk. You’ll know what to do.
Let’s find a place to make a portal. Start looking around.
The recipe calls for a Sin eater and plenty of runestones. Find us a portal, my pet.
A Sin Eater--! Let’s go there, quick as we can.
I sense a Sin Eater. Ready to go?
I located an obelisk. Ready when you are.
I feel it. The Sin Eater. Let me take us to it.
Ohh, I could curl up and sleep right now. Sooo satisfying...
Didn’t know how empty I felt until I was restored.
Feeling like myself again. Shall we go raise some hell?
A battle and a meal. You know how to show a girl a good time...
So long, Kortifex -- and thanks for the chow!
Sorry to eat and run, but we have places to be...
Back to full strength. Now let’s stir up some trouble.
I feel... renewed. Nicely done, plaything.
The Sin Eater flees. Find it, plaything!
Find that obelisk. It’s around here somewhere...
The Sin Eater moved. Why can’t that thing stay put?
Find the obelisk. I need to feed!
And there goes the Sin Eater...
Leaving so soon? How rude.
That obelisk is playing hard to get.
I’m surprised it doesn’t laugh every time it runs off.
Find the obelisk. Feed it runestones and we can take back what Kortifex steals.
Solution: take the runestones dropped by dead revenants and feed them to the Sin Eater.
There is a Sin Eater obelisk nearby. It can help us take back our power.
You can restore us by gathering runestones and putting them in the Sin Eater obelisk.
Feed them to the Sin Eater. Now let us bathe in the blood of our enemies!
The Sin Eater feeds on runestones. And it shares its bounty with us.
Take the runestones to the obelisk. Enough of them, and our power is restored.
The Sin Eater hungers for runestones. Feed it and we win.
Ignore that idiot. Just kill and fill.
Meh. I’ve been threatened by better. Now get those runestones -- I’m starving!
Oh, you humans do get full of yourselves. Now fetch some runestones and feed that Sin Eater.
If I had a runestone for every mortal who threatened me... I’d fill a Sin Eater with them!
Ahhhh, yessss! Stolen power... Delectable...
Mmmmm... The wage of sin is... delectable.
Feel that power, coursing through our limbs? Worth every bullet.
Ohhh, my strength is returning. Thank you, plaything. You did well.
“Like stealing candy from a baby.” That’s a saying, right?
The tank is full -- let’s hit the road!
You stole this from me, Kortifex. I’m just taking it back.
Now that hit the spot!
Kill and fill, playthings. I require sustenance.
Drop these dead soldiers and collect their runestones. Chop-chop!
Fill the obelisk. Let nothing stand in your way.
We’re fading, human. Gather some runestones and restore our strength.
See the Sin Eater obelisk? Get some runestones in that thing, quick as you can.
Kill the revenants, pick up runestones, feed the beast. Got it?
Here we go! Bring on the Sin Eater.
Fill the obelisk with runestones. Show us some love.
Remember, Kortifex won’t make this easy for us.
Prepare to kill and collect...
Runestones, here we come...
Fight hard, human. I really need this...
Get ready to take back what is ours.
You got the stones for this, human? You will...
Kortifex hates it when we do this...
Ready to fetch some runestones? You better be...
subtitle_zm_cmcp_obsc/zm_cmcp_obsc_krft_: Kortifex’s barrier spell continues to drain your demon’s power.
Feeling sluggish? Kortifex’s magic steals your demon’s power.
That grand containment spell all around us? It weakens your demon.
Time again to deal with Kortifex, and his theft of your demon’s power.
Kortifex steals our power. Take it back.
Time to feed your demons, my friends.
Saraxis, show them how to steal back power.
Saraxis, it’s time to feed.
Excellent. We need our symbiotic spirits at full strength.
Remember, demons, not to bite the hand that feeds you.
Even Dark Aether entities have their needs.
Keep your ghostly “partners” strong. We are  certainly in this together.
The stronger your demons, the better our chance of success.
Good job, everyone, but we may need to do this again, and soon.
We look out for each other. That is why we’ll win.
Remember this, demons. You need your mortal partners.
Kortifex’s containment spell slowly drains your demonic partner’s energy.
Krafft here. I’ve noticed that Kortifex’s magic is slowly draining your demon’s energies.
We have a problem: Kortifex’s rune magic is leeching energy from your demons.
Somehow, Kortifex’s barrier spell is drawing energy from your demon-partners.
Some revenants drop runestones when they die. They are rife with Kortifex’s power.
Look for runestones when you kill your enemies. They are filled with power stolen from your demons.
Pick up runestones dropped by revenants. They contain demonic energies.
Kill your enemies. Pick up runestones when they drop them.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_obsc/zm_cmcp_obsc_krtx_: Hrrr... Runestones. My enemies must be starving.
No, mortals. I won’t let you take even a fraction of my power!
They are using a Sin Eater. Heh, they’re getting desperate.
Rise, revenants. They are taking power that belongs to me!
Blood-sucking insects -- that is my power you are stealing!
Runestones. Mere pin-pricks... but they add up.
I took that power from your new masters, and what I take I keep!
No one steals from Kortifex! Destroy them, my revenants!
subtitle_zm_cmcp_obsc/zm_cmcp_obsc_vlst_: Stop this outrage, Kortifex! This theft cannot be allowed!
Nein! I will not let you fill that thing!
More soldiers! Rise up! Stop the thieves this instant!
Verdammt! If they succeed, their demons will be worse than ever.
Kortifex, they are doing it again! Stop them!
Scheisse! Can no one keep them from that obelisk?!
Nein, soldiers! If you steal from Kortifex, you steal from me!
Thieving vermin! You will pay for every runestone -- I swear it!
Fools. You are in my crosshairs now. My revenants will overwhelm you.
Fight them all you want -- my soldiers will drag you down.
Kortifex tells me you are trying to use that obelisk. I guess that’s as good a reason as any to die.
I had a feeling you would try to use the Sin Eater. I’m afraid it is you who’ll be devoured.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_rbzg/zm_cpm4_rbm4_blkr_: You won a corrupted heart. Strengthen yourself at the Altar of Covenants or the Tome of Rituals.
You have earned a corrupted heart. The altar and the tome await.
The Altar of Covenants and the Tome of Rituals hunger for that heart you won.
Do not forget to spend corrupted hearts, my pupil.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_rbzg/zm_cpm4_rbm4_dnrt_: Corrupted hearts can boost my power. Visit the Tome and find out.
If you need a covenant, or would increase my power, then spend that heart, soldier.
Spend that heart you just won at the Altar of Covenants and the Tome of Rituals.
Give that corrupted heart to the Altar or the Tome. We need what it can buy.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_rbzg/zm_cpm4_rbm4_dnvk_: You picked up a corrupted heart. Don’t let it go unspent.
That rotting heart in your pocket? That’s your ticket to power.
The Altar. The Tome. Feed them hearts and reap rewards.
A corrupted heart that goes unspent is a lost opportunity.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_rbzg/zm_cpm4_rbm4_dsrx_: Picked up a heart, did you? Let’s go shopping!
That corrupted heart you just won? Use it to buy me something nice.
You won a rotten heart! Lucky you! Now go spend it.
Take that heart to the book or the antler-guy. See what they’ll give ya for it.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_rbzg/zm_cpm4_rbm4_krft_: Attention: the Runegate is available. You may now exfiltrate.
My allies, if you need to “exfil,” the Runegate is now active.
Should you need to withdraw, you may now use the Runegate.
The Runegate is active. “Exfil” if you must.
Be advised: the Runegate is ready to exfiltrate you... if necessary.
The Runegate is now active. You may use it to withdraw from combat.
Krafft here. If retreat becomes necessary, “exfil” is available.
My allies, do you need to “exfil”? Then head to the Runegate.
Tactical retreat is now an option, courtesy of the Runegate.
The Runegate is available. You may exfiltrate while it’s active.
Runegate no longer available. I’ll alert you when you can exfil again.
The Runegate has closed. I’ll let you know when you can exfil again.
It seems the Runegate must rest. Exfiltration must wait, for now.
The Runegate has gone dormant. You can exfil later.
You must fight on, my friends, till the Runegate powers up again.
Exfiltration window is closed, my allies. Another will open soon.
Exfil is no-go. The Runegate needs time to recharge.
Attention: you can no longer exfil until the Runegate reawakens.
The Runegate used up its charge. I’ll tell you next time you can exfil.
The Runegate powered down. You’ll have to fight until it opens again.
subtitle_zm_cmcp_rbzg/zm_cpm4_rbm4_vrcn_: Remember: corrupted hearts can be spent at the Altar and the Tome.
Each corrupted heart buys you power from the Tome of Rituals or the Altar of Covenants.
A rotting heart is a foul prize -- so trade it for something better.
Visit the Tome or the Altar, now that you have a heart to give away.
Yes. Open up the whole area. The forces of Death must not box you in.
More room to spread your tendrils.
That’s right, seedling. Open the whole place up.
The more obstacles you clear, the more you can run free.
Keep it up. We need all the room we can get.
The way is open, thanks to you.
We let nothing stand in our way, my child.
subtitle_zm_cp45_zikn/zm_cp45_zikn_iken_: Certainly.
Affirmative. Now watch and learn...
I know what to do.
The work continues.
Whatever is necessary, I will do it.
No trouble at all.
Understood. I will comply.
I will see it through.
Copy that.
Orders received.
Was that your teeth or your nails? Either way -- OW!
Agh! I got careless there...
Uncivilized brute.
Damn, they can throw a punch!
You drew first blood -- I will draw last.
You just made your final mistake.
I am not your punching bag.
You will pay for that!
Damn your claws!
They strike hard!
You honor us all, my furry friend.
Monkey stole their lives... and my heart.
And the pawn becomes a queen.
Monkey was neither a tool nor a toy. He was our friend.
Such sacrifice is rarely seen outside the chessboard.
That’s right, monkey -- draw them in and knock them down.
This is my square.
You walked right into it.
You led with your chin.
Knocked you out...
Ikenna takes revenant.
Too stupid, too slow.
Allow me to recommend you a dentist.
Next time, keep your hands up.
Should have kept your distance.
Next!
You lost your head. For real!
Their glowing eyes are hard to miss.
Bullet, one. Brain, zero.
Glowing eyes make excellent targets.
Headshots work. That is just science.
Ventilated your skull.
Few things are more effective than a bullet to the head.
It was not using that brain anyway.
I will not miss that face.
Head blown off, down goes the revenant.
Sturmkrieger scrapped.
Down for the count...
What a mess it made dying.
Strategy beats size every time.
Even a king falls to a well-placed pawn.
In the end, all that firepower was for nothing.
Not the first heavyweight I’ve dropped.
Well armed but still mindless.
What happened? I thought we’d go the full twelve rounds?
Big. Bad. Buried.
Against the undead, I hold nothing back.
No point counting when they just keep coming.
I am nothing if not efficient.
Back to the ground you all go!
I will dig them deeper graves!
Sorry, but you all have to go.
Fewer soldiers for you, Von List!
Today I am a one-man army.
Von List, I am taking all your pawns!
Hell just got a little more crowded.
Still think attacking me was a good idea?
You should have hit me harder the first time.
Do not send a pawn to do the job of a rook.
It does not take an engineer to see where that was going.
By my calculations, you got what you deserved.
You dished out what you could not take.
You should have planned for that outcome.
Not even close!
Revenge is nasty business.
That was payback.
I respect most opponents -- but not you.
Coming back as a screamer is a fate worse than death.
How I hate those screamers...
Went out like he came in -- obnoxious.
You clearly did not understand the element of surprise.
Grenades on legs...
Your tactics need work, Von List!
Damned screamers!
You had your say -- and I had mine.
Exploding when shot. I call that a design flaw.
I believe I will need this.
Every piece on the board has its purpose...
Waste not, want not.
A most useful item.
You never know when this could come in handy.
Into my pack you go.
This belongs to me now.
I will take it.
Only a fool would pass this up.
I can put this to good use.
This will silence the opposition.
Good things come in full-metal packages.
Heavy gun, but it pulls its weight.
This gun, it is a game-changer.
Buckle up -- I have a belt full of lead here.
I am no stranger to close combat.
At least with this I won’t have to reload.
I will put down the revenants any way I can.
If blood is spilled today, it won’t be mine.
A crude weapon... but effective.
Sometimes a weapon like this carries you.
An engineer, but a marksman first.
I will make every shot count.
The essential infantry weapon.
A soldier’s closest friend.
Hits like an uppercut.
There is something... primal about shotguns.
Not much range, but plenty of power.
Step too close and you will be sorry.
Boom! Knockout.
In the ring, or on the battlefield -- punch them fast and hard.
Speed kills -- and these shoot fast.
This will cut the revenants to pieces.
I will need lots of bullets today.
Feeling better about my chances now.
Opportunity is in my sights.
Sniping takes a steady hand and a patient mind.
This rifle rewards skill.
I've never trained as a sniper. But I am a fast learner.
Sniping requires strategy. Good thing that’s my strong point.
This gun checks all the boxes.
Such rifles are the future of combat.
Serious matters call for assault rifles.
An ugly tool for a necessary task.
I am no one's pawn with this in my hands.
An appropriate tool for the job.
Not my first choice, but it will do.
I have knocked out opponents with lesser weapons.
I succeed with whatever is at hand.
Finely crafted and fully loaded.
More power to you, demon. Do not make me regret it.
Demon, you are moving up in rank.
This is the first book I have seen that I do not want to read.
Your abilities increase, demon. Let’s put them to work.
I hunger for knowledge. This book hungers for hearts.
More power is good, but that book... is not.
