How desperate are you now that we found half the relic?
We will keep them from this “Construct” you speak of, Saraxis, now that the relic is restored.
Be sure to collect it from the podium, my allies. And gather anything else you have won.
We will need it all for our final battle on the sands of Egypt.
Cyphers like that one require a written encryption key. See if you can find one.
Er... we should look for an encryption key. Not a literal key, but a code written on paper.
Die Wahrheit troops often write down encryption “keys.” Perhaps they left one in the area.
Die Wahrheit uses disappearing ink for such documents.
Vercanna, this is all going wrong!
subtitle_zm_cpm4_mqs4/zm_cpm4_mqs4_krtx_: Stop them, Von List! Some secrets are better left forgotten!
You don’t know what you are doing, Saraxis. Ignorance truly is bliss.
Don’t do this, Saraxis. You will not like what you find out.
Throw everything at them, Von List! My secrets are mine alone!
Von List, they are getting too close! Guard my secrets, damn you!
No! The red-bloods already know too much! Save her, revenants!
That damned echo will not shut up! Keep them from wearing her down, my puppets!
subtitle_zm_cpm4_mqs4/zm_cpm4_mqs4_vlst_: No wonder my men could not find that verdammt mirror.
Die Wahrheit would never stoop to drinking the blood of revenants.
How desperate are your soldiers that they would drink the blood of the undead?
They are too close to succeeding. Rise, revenants! We cannot falter now!
I know what you are doing now -- and I will not allow it! Rise, revenants!
Oh, no you don’t. Kortifex wants her past to stay buried. Destroy them, my revenants!
This has gone far enough. Kill them, my puppets!
subtitle_zm_cpm4_mqs4/zm_cpm4_mqs4_vrcn_: You found the monolith. Good.
We can use it to summon the memories stolen from Saraxis.
That’s it. That’s the key to summoning Saraxis’s memories.
That monolith is a focal point for Saraxis’s lost memories.
You did it. The monolith is fully unveiled.
Alas, it appears to be incomplete. A mechanism is missing.
Wait. There is a mechanism missing. Our soldiers have recovered part of it, but...
The three machine pieces the seedlings found must be placed on the carving.
You see, Saraxis? Reassembling your memories must be done carefully. Deliberately.
Seedling soldiers, take both pieces to the dig site. Understood?
Indeed. It must be reforged at the excavation area.
Take both pieces to the dig site. Place them on the stone podium.
I will do what I can to guide your search.
I shall help them search -- in my own way.
Look around, seedlings. I will help, if I can.
The encryption “key.” Hmm. Half of the writing appears to be missing.
Well, seedlings? Put that code to use.
Well done. Now, to awaken the monolith and summon Saraxis’s lost memories.
Now comes the hard part. You must rouse the monolith from its slumbers.
Brace yourselves. Summoning lost memories can be hazardous to your health.
You came up short, seedlings. Wait, then try again.
We missed this chance, but the monument will reawaken. Just wait.
Do not give up, soldiers. The monument will soon be ready again.
Nobody said this would be easy. Wait now, then try again.
The monument is ready! Brace yourself, Saraxis...
At last, the monument awakens. Now, Saraxis: face your past.
Do you feel it, Saraxis? Your past is coming back to haunt you.
The monument has all it needs. Watch, Saraxis. This is for you...
Behold, Saraxis: the echo of your lost memories.
Careful. I doubt she will be glad to see you.
The two halves of that mirror lie between this world and the Dark Aether -- just beyond our sight.
This is why Die Wahrheit could never find it.
We need only find a way to open their seedling eyes...
That’s it! Let the blood of revenants fill the fountain.
Now drink, and see as the dead see.
You will have to work quickly, before your second sight wears off. Is that clear?
The revenant blood wore off. You can try again if you wish.
You’ll need more revenant blood if you wish to continue.
Second sight fades, but you know you can go back for more.
That drink of revenant blood has run its course. You can always have another.
Your vision fades, but you can restore it with more revenant blood.
Alas, revenant-vision is temporary. Drink more of their blood if you must.
Empty. But you know how to fill it again, don’t you, child?
All gone. I’m afraid “the Flogger” must feast again.
You’ll have to refill that fountain, my child.
Another batch of revenants must be sacrificed before you drink again.
There’s no more left. You will have to refill it.
The fountain ran dry. Bleed some more revenants, my soldier.
Follow that orb! Quickly -- while your second sight lasts!
Stay after that orb. Your second sight could fade at any moment.
That orb will lead you to the relic, but only as long as you can see it.
Do not lose sight of that orb. It will leads you to the relic.
Good. Now that the pieces are in place, we must charge up the podium.
Take your places, seedlings.
Fusing that mirror back together requires energizing the podium.
Get in position, soldiers.
That podium can restore the mirror relic, but only if we provide it with power.
Now take your place and recommit yourself to our mission.
No! Hunt down your orb -- force it back into place. Immediately!
Seedling, fetch that orb back to its place. Hurry!
Do not let your orb fly free. Make it return to that spot.
Get in position, seedlings. You know what to do.
Steel yourselves: you must fight for the rest of Saraxis’s memories.
Take your positions and prepare to fight. The Echo of Saraxis must be brought to heel.
Take your place and gird your loins. The Echo of Saraxis won’t easily give up her secrets.
No, professor. Defeating the Echo is how we restore the broken mirror -- and get Saraxis her memories back.
Seedling soldiers: charge up the mirror halves. Your so-called “wonder weapon” is the key.
The mirror halves are all charged up. Now lure the Echo close to it.
Now, seedlings! Wear her down while she is stunned!
She’s dropped her defenses. Take her down!
Strike now! Weaken her!
Some things must be learned the hard way.
subtitle_zm_cpm4_rbm4/zm_cpm4_rbm4_blkr_: With it, we can separate Von List from Kortifex and finally end their threat.
Her artifact was recovered here, but the relic was never found.
It was used to sever the bond between Saraxis and her human host. We must do the same to Kortifex.
Long ago, her enemies used a certain relic to cast Saraxis out of her human host.
Find a way to fill it, my pupils. It may provide you valuable... insights.
Yes. We must find a way to fill it. I suspect we need its power.
It is for us to replenish -- and see for ourselves what it brings.
I know not, but find a way to fill it and let us see what power it grants.
That will not open until power is restored.
That gate has a power source. Find it, my pupil.
That will remain locked until its power source is active.
No power, no passage. Let us go find the switch.
Oh, I can feel the power coursing.
subtitle_zm_cpm4_rbm4/zm_cpm4_rbm4_dsrx_: That memory is... gone. There’s a lot I can’t remember about my past.
Sorry, no. There are big gaps in my memory -- including most of my youth in the Dark Aether.
I... I can’t remember. It’s like that memory got plucked right out of my head.
Thing is, I can’t remember. Either I blocked out the trauma, or my memories were stolen.
subtitle_zm_cpm4_rbm4/zm_cpm4_rbm4_krft_: This is professor Krafft. You are there to find a powerful relic once used to trap Saraxis in her artifact.
Open all barriers and explore the dig site. Understood?
Krafft to Special Forces: long ago, Saraxis was ambushed in that swamp. A special relic was used to trap her.
Search the excavations, find it, and we finally have a weapon that can defeat Von List.
Professor Krafft here. That spellbook page we stole from Von List mentioned a powerful relic.
Die Wahrheit unearthed Saraxis’ artifact in that dig site. The relic must be close by. Find it.
Krafft to Special Forces. That swamp is where Die Wahrheit found the artifact of Saraxis.
Find that relic, and we’ll do the same to Kortifex and Von List. Search the excavations.
Saraxis, can you tell us what the relic actually looked like? Might help us find it.
The relic we seek -- can you describe it to us, Saraxis?
So. What does the relic look like, Saraxis?
Saraxis, it would help if we knew what the relic looks like.
My allies, have you found--
I think you know, Oberführer. It’s in your voice -- you are worried.
Krafft here. Any progress on--
Oh, you know what we are here for, Von List. And still you cannot stop us.
Special Forces, have you located the--
Ignore Von List. He knows how close we are to ending all his schemes.
My friends, is your search--
When we do, Oberführer, there will be nowhere you can hide.
Die Wahrheit worked on some new tricks here -- including that trap.
Von List’s soldiers created some interesting traps here. Might be useful.
We should consider using these traps left behind by Die Wahrheit.
The traps left behind by Von List could prove useful -- if we can get them to work.
How odd. Those fountains are usually full.
An empty fountain. Should it not be filled with demon blood?
How strange. Did someone forget to fill that fountain?
Why is that fountain empty?
This is where they unearthed the Dragon of Saraxis.
I have seen so many of these excavations. So many treasures plundered.
Die Wahrheit came here based on my research.
This dig site. [sigh] It pains me to see archaeology in the service of evil.
Any revenant passing through this is, er... in for quite a shock.
Huh. “Abandon all hope, ye who enter here.”
Well... at least they’ll die quickly.
Anything that crosses this threshold... is ashes.
Oh, my. They weren’t going for subtlety with this.
I almost pity the poor, undead wretches!
Stand clear, my friends. Not that you need me to tell you...
Whoever designed this, er, “flogger” is one sick individual.
subtitle_zm_cpm4_rbm4/zm_cpm4_rbm4_vlst_: Found what, Professor? What do you hope to accomplish in that swamp of death?
On getting yourselves killed? Because all you will find here is death.
It does not matter what your pack of mongrels digs up. This will be their final mission.
They can search all they want. If my men could not find that relic, no one can.
Don’t you mean “where we unearthed it,” herr professor?
Feeling guilty about your life’s work, professor?
And you are lucky we found something, you wretched old man.
“Evil.” Such a simplistic word. Die Wahrheit’s mission is not for you to judge.
subtitle_zm_cpm4_rbm4/zm_cpm4_rbm4_vrcn_: Then we must summon those memories. There is a stone monolith nearby. Let us begin there.
There is a certain monolith nearby that can help you recall. Find it, seedlings.
There is a way to summon lost memories.
Seedlings: look for a monolith covered in plant growth.
There is a carved monolith here that can... “unblock” you. Seedling soldiers, you must find it.
Careful, child. Swamp water can slow you down.
Running through waist-deep muck is perhaps not the greatest idea.
You do know you are slower in that water, yes?
Not as bad as running through quicksand -- but not much better.
subtitle_zm_cpm4_wws4/zm_cpm4_wws4_blkr_: Strange. That glass bulb seems connected to the device in the doorway.
That item -- I believe you call it a “vacuum tube” -- it’s connected to the door.
Use that fuse you already picked up.
They already picked up a spare.
My pupil already found one.
Excellent. That tube is operational.
I believe you have charged the tube.
The vacuum tube hums with the essence of the dead.
There, on that radio -- a vacuum tube. See if you can get it to function.
That glass bulb on the radio. Is it functional?
Check that tube on the radio. Does it still work?
Part of Von List’s so-called “wonder weapon.” I suspect it could have more than one use.
That belongs to an experimental weapon, but I think it has other uses.
A gun barrel. Could be useful in other ways, too.
Check that vacuum tube. See if it can be used to complete Die Wahrheit’s “wonder weapon.”
Remove it from the radio. Grab the weapon barrel while you are at it.
That tube, and the weapon barrel, are needed if we are to steal Von List’s “wunderwaffe.”
We will need that vacuum tube. But the mechanism it is connected to must first be empowered.
If we can provide a power source, we can recharge that vacuum tube.
We should find a source of electricity for that device.
It is working! Her attacks are charging the device!
That mechanism -- Krafft calls it a “Tesla coil” -- it is charging up.
Good, good... Zaballa’s lightning strikes are energizing the device.
Success! Now collect that tube. We have a weapon to construct.
The tube is charged. Bring it along, my pupils.
Thanks to Zaballa, we have a fully charged weapon component. Grab it.
subtitle_zm_cpm4_wws4/zm_cpm4_wws4_krft_: There -- on the workbench. Von List always talked about creating a wunderwaffe -- a “wonder weapon.”
Those components on the workbench. Is that... a “wonder weapon”?
What manner of experiment is that on the workbench?
Where does that wire lead? The one linked to the vacuum tube.
Ach! It seems you blew a fuse. My allies, can you find a replacement?
Was that the circuit breaker? You may need to find another fuse.
That fuse is kaput. Can you find a spare?
Perhaps we should finish charging that vacuum tube.
Good. Now get that vacuum tube charged up.
Draw them into the trap to charge the vacuum tube.
No, the missing parts must be there, somewhere.
Whatever is missing will be close by.
The missing components are surely there somewhere.
Taking one step closer to acquiring your wunderwaffe.
My people are trained to improvise. Yours are simply thugs.
You seem awfully worried about something that “will never work.”
My allies, it worked! The radio is fully powered!
Excellent! The vacuum tube is fully recharged.
I believe that vacuum tube is ready for use.
Set it back up, my allies. Then wait for it to charge.
“Where there is life, there is hope.” Set it back up, my soldiers.
Ignore him, Special Forces. Set it back up and try again.
Kind of you to create it, Oberführer. We shall put it to good use.
As you can see, they are fast learners.
We shall do our best to make certain it is. For you.
subtitle_zm_cpm4_wws4/zm_cpm4_wws4_vlst_: Keep your filthy hands off my equipment. You simpletons will ruin all my work.
The word is wunderwaffe -- and I told my men to evacuate with the prototype!
Nein, leave the Wunderwaffe DG-2 alone! My wonder weapon is for better men than you.
My men scuttled the radio -- as instructed. Your meddling is at an end.
My men rendered the radio worthless. Too bad.
Did you expect us to leave the camp intact?
Krafft, what are your people doing?
Seriously? A gun barrel antenna? You actually expect that to work?
I have had enough of your interference. Rise, revenants! Destroy the radio tower!
Your people go too far, Krafft. Now watch as my revenants tear down your antenna.
Ha! My puppets destroyed your antenna!
You could not hold back my army. You are lucky to be alive.
Your ridiculous antenna was all too easy to tear down.
Nein! The DG-2 was not meant for vermin such as you!
Your soldiers are too ignorant to properly wield such a weapon.
The DG-2, in enemy hands. This is a disaster!
subtitle_zm_cpm4_wws4/zm_cpm4_wws4_vrcn_: If only we knew someone with electrical attacks...
Does Zaballa the Deceiver count as a “power source”?
Wait long enough, and the electricity will come to us.
subtitle_zm_cpm5_bfs5/zm_cpm5_bfs5_blkr_: Kortifex will return. Do what you must to be ready.
Use this moment to prepare yourselves, my pupils.
We did it, Professor. You, your soldiers... all of us.
subtitle_zm_cpm5_bfs5/zm_cpm5_bfs5_dcmt_: None shall harm thee. This I swear!
Oh Kortifex. Is this your best? I am laughing!
Worry not -- I can take punishment.
Did you feel that, warrior? I certainly did.
Do not worry. The Decimator feels... no pain!
subtitle_zm_cpm5_bfs5/zm_cpm5_bfs5_dnrt_: They are worthy to challenge you, Kortifex. And you are not the Archon yet.
It seems even an Archon can have a weak spot.
Good shooting. But he still has two eyes left...
Use this respite to fortify yourselves.
We must find a way past his defenses.
Strike now! He has dropped his defenses!
Two eyes down. Getting worried yet, Kortifex?
Get whatever you need. He will come back stronger.
Third eye gone! You did it! Death has finally come for Kortifex the Deathless!
Let the bottomless depths of the Dark Aether claim his corpse.
subtitle_zm_cpm5_bfs5/zm_cpm5_bfs5_dnvk_: Talk is cheap, Kortifex! Courage is all that counts!
Gather whatever you need before he returns.
That son of a bitch is stealing my Ring of Fire!
Hrr! He’s augmenting his attack with my power.
How is he stealing my power?!
My Ring of Fire is supercharging his lightning!
I do not like having my own power turned against me.
Load up, gear up and get ready. We’ll have one more shot at Kortifex.
True, but not the way you think.
subtitle_zm_cpm5_bfs5/zm_cpm5_bfs5_dsrx_: He’s turning my powers against us.
That sneaky shit! He’s using my power.
He took my memories, now he’s using my attack?!
Watch it -- he’s borrowing my boom.
Better stock up, playthings. He won’t be gone for long.
We’ll get one last crack at him. Better get ready...
subtitle_zm_cpm5_bfs5/zm_cpm5_bfs5_krft_: No deal, Kortifex! Take him down, my allies!
subtitle_zm_cpm5_bfs5/zm_cpm5_bfs5_krtx_: What do you mean, “they’re back”?!
No! Somehow, those insects have passed your trials!
Are you so certain?
Welcome to your doom!
Rest assured, I will destroy your world -- just as soon as I kill you here.
I will strike you all down!
I am like unto a god now!
I shall fry you where you stand!
Let the heavens unleash my wrath!
The elements are mine to command!
Die, red-bloods! Die!
Rise up, my soldiers of death!
The dead hunger for your flesh!
Devour them, my children!
The hordes of Kortifex are upon you!
Pull them down! Tear them apart!
More revenants! Overwhelm them!
Damn you, red-bloods! I’ll make you suffer for that!
You took my eye. I’ll take your lives!
Hah! You red-bloods cannot penetrate my rune shield.
How is this possible?! I am the Archon!
You’ve cost me much, red-bloods -- but that ends now.
subtitle_zm_cpm5_bfs5/zm_cpm5_bfs5_vrcn_: Now would be a good time to rearm. Kortifex will be back.
The anemones that sprouted up here might just be the key.
These anemones have lain dormant since Kortifex destroyed the Wilds.
The power of the Construct awakened them -- like seedlings bathed in sunshine.
They’re dangerous, but feed them right and they share their power.
Guard that anemone while it gestates the crystal.
Now protect the anemone. This will take a moment...
That’s right. Now guard the anemone.
Protect the anemone and you’ll be rewarded.
Quickly -- use the anemone’s gift.
Take what the anemone birthed.
The anemone has something for you.
See what the anemone cooked up?
Resupply yourselves. When he returns, you had better be ready.
Now he is stealing my power for himself!
No! My Healing Aura was never meant for a god of death!
How is he borrowing my Healing Aura?
He’s healing himself -- with my power!
He’s using my Healing Aura. Sacrilege!
Kortifex borrows my power. It’s a crime against Nature!
subtitle_zm_cpm5_mqs5/zm_cpm5_mqs5_dcmt_: Hail! The Decimator welcomes his brothers and sisters in arms!
That pillar signifies the Construct’s Trial of Resilience. Ready to prove your skill and speed?
Ah, the Orb wants you to gather three items -- but beware: each of them are cursed.
The Orb says, “Seek your enemy’s crowning glory.”
The Orb says, “Search your enemy’s home away from home.”
The Orb says, “Seek that which lies just beneath the skin.”
The Orb says, “Search the place where fortunes were made.”
The Orb says, “Seek what you need to make a stand.”
The Orb says, “Search the place where a journey ended.”
Alas, you took too long. Try again.
Out of time, soldier. Be faster next time.
Your time ran out, but I know you can do this if you try again.
Find that item again. And this time move it!
You’ll have to be faster if you want to pass this trial.
Try again, soldier. You took too long.
Nicely done! Now go get another.
The Orb approves. Now do it again.
Swift and skillful! Can you do it again?
That’s right -- show that Orb you are truly worthy.
Ha! Let nothing slow you down, my friend.
Making good progress, but the Orb demands more.
And now the final test of speed and skill!
The Trial of Resilience will now be decided!
The Trial is in session. You will be judged.
Show the Construct what you are made of, my friends.
The Trial of Resilience is now in session.
I have seen your resilience. Now show it to the Construct.
I’m free! Use me to smash the Syphoncores!
Ha! It seems I get to help you now!
My friends, I am back in the fight! Whom among you may I protect?
Huzzah! The Decimator is back in action!
Someone come pick me up! I have a feeling you will need me!
The Decimator returns to battle! And not a moment too soon!
That’s it! Now take it to yon fountain.
All soldiers carry water for their cause. In this case, literally.
Careful now, don’t spill it.
That precious fluid must make it to the fountain, understand?
Getting that to the fountain is your only mission now.
Precious cargo -- do not drop it.
No, Norticus. We do not need Von List. These mortals have proven themselves.
Listen to me! I was once like Von List -- cruel, ambitious... useless.
subtitle_zm_cpm5_mqs5/zm_cpm5_mqs5_dnrt_: Behold! The podium appears. Place the Bronze Mirror upon it.
Somebody mount the mirror upon that stone podium.
See the podium? Time to put that mirror relic to work.
I spy the podium. Put the mirror in place, o soldiers of Norticus.
Shoot him, mortal!
Professor, he is right. “Justice” will have to wait.
No. That was the almighty Construct. We have... disturbed it.
The Construct is... selective about whom it grants power. Not just anyone can become its Archon.
Your memory proved true. But the runes left something to remember them by.
That stone signifies the Trial of Mindfulness. Show the Construct you are more than mindless brutes.
The Orb bids you approach it for your first test.
Look carefully. Memorize those runes.
Remember what you see. Our success depends on this.
These runes are important. Do not forget them.
Memorize these symbols. Focus your mind.
Your mind is a steel trap. Ensnare what you see.
Remember these symbols. Keep them fresh in your mind’s eye.
Control Runes. You should know what to do.
The same runes the Orb showed you. Capture them.
Occupy the Control Runes. They match the ones the Orb revealed.
Think carefully. You know what to do with Control Runes.
You did it! Now survive the rune’s effect.
You solved the puzzle, but there’s a cost...
You used your wits, but the runes took a parting shot.
Good news: you succeeded. Bad news: the runes left their curse.
You outsmarted the Orb. Now outlast what the runes did to you.
Professor...? Are you there?
That... was ill-advised. We needed his counsel to stop Kortifex.
Decimator, maybe you should--
This is it. The final battle, eons in the making.
subtitle_zm_cpm5_mqs5/zm_cpm5_mqs5_dnvk_: The Bronze Mirror awakens! Von List has nowhere left to hide.
Now, mirror! Cleave our enemies in twain!
Brace yourself, Von List! You’re not going to like this...
The relic is charged. Kortifex! Say goodbye to your pet!
Execute the bastard!
Get through that portal, soldiers! Kortifex must be stopped!
To find out if they are worthy of challenging Kortifex.
It grants them certain trials to prove themselves.
That obelisk signifies the Trial of Sacrifice. Hrrr. War is always about loss.
You lit a torch. Now light the others.
See that torch you lit. Do it again.
Ah. Yes. Light the other torches.
This could work. If you light more torches.
The Orb demands a sacrifice. One of your packed weapons will do.
It wants a weapon empowered by the Pack-a-Punch. What are you willing to give up?
It asks you to sacrifice a packed weapon. What would you give up for victory?
The Orb demands a weapon enhanced by the Pack-a-Punch. A worthy sacrifice.
The Orb demands a sacrifice. Make sure what you offer it is suitable.
It wants a worthy sacrifice. What are you willing to give up?
It asks you to sacrifice something of real value. What would you give up for victory?
The Orb demands a worthy sacrifice. Give it something you will truly miss.
For this, you need my Ring of Fire...
My Ring of Fire will help you through this next challenge.
The last challenge begins. Call upon my power when you must.
This part, I remember. You will need my power to get through it.
Good! Kill them all! Quickly -- or you will run out of time!
That’s right -- slay them before your time runs out!
Keep killing! The clock is ticking!
That’s the idea! Destroy your foes before time runs out!
Answer him, mortal!
He’s right. The day we need a Nazi is the day I hang up my sword.
Either Kortifex dies, or we do.
subtitle_zm_cpm5_mqs5/zm_cpm5_mqs5_krft_: He is trapped inside his artifact.
My friends, is it over? Did our plan succeed?
Ahh!
My allies, Von List just... appeared in my room. Kortifex must have teleported him to me!
I have him at gunpoint.
Your death would not bother me in the least. It would be justice.
Just keep him away from it at all costs!
Mein Gott! Did Kortifex do that?
Somebody tell me what just happened.
But why did it spare my allies?
That seemed to do the trick!
They know you hold my spouse hostage. And when this is over they will demand Sasha’s return.
Good. Good. Keep filling that fountain.
That’s progress, but we need to fill it more.
It will take more than that to fill the fountain.
Bravo. Now go get some more.
Yes, my allies! Keep pouring it on!
Excellent. Now gather more and finish the job!
We did that long ago. And the last thing we seek is your approval.
Or a hostage. You taught me that.
Well... you’re the expert on the musings of the damned...
There is no “us,” Oberführer. Not until you return my spouse.
We need your knowledge. You need my soldiers. This is only a marriage of convenience.
We are not “partners.” You are the man who tortured my beloved Sasha, and so you remain.
Not until you give me back my spouse, you bastard.
Damn you, Von List! You should have warned us this would happen!
Von List! Did you know it would summon a Sturmkrieger?!
Look out! That is one nasty Sturmkrieger.
Dammit, Von List. If you knew it would summon that Sturmkrieger you should have said so!
And yours were all sacrificed -- on the altar of your ambition.
Some more than others.
Had they not, you would have been next, Oberführer.
Sacrificing others, that you understand. But self-sacrifice? Never your strong point.
Where is Sasha? If your troops are all dead, then who guards my spouse?
Finding love was my greatest accomplishment. So where is my Sasha now?
And then we can discuss a trial of your own, Von List.
Men and women. You always had too narrow a view of humanity.
Ach. We must begin again.
You left the area. This is a do-over now.
You wandered too far, my friend. Try again and stay closer to the obelisk.
Remember: stay close to the obelisk until the effect wears off.
You left the area. I am afraid you’ll have to try again.
Alas, you strayed too far from the Obelisk. Try again.
Success! You are one last challenge away from completing the Trial.
You have shown your mental acuity. One more challenge to overcome.
Excellent! Now go to the Obelisk to complete the trial.
The Trial of Mindfulness has one last challenge. Go to the obelisk.
Return to the Obelisk. One more challenge to go...
